raw.description:
Business Introduction

GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.

Position Summary

The Senior Director, Technology Risk & Compliance Business Partners - GSC & OT will set direction for the Technology Risk & Compliance Business Partners - GSC & OT capability across GSK and lead the organisation that delivers it. This is a senior leadership role accountable for the capability across GSK. This role covers Global Supply Chain and Operational Technology, including manufacturing and laboratory systems.

About the team. The Technology Risk and Compliance Business Partners are the face of the Cyber Security Office to GSK's business and technology areas. Each partner owns the cyber risk and compliance relationship for an assigned area, translating central strategy into what that area actually needs to do, and bringing its risk back into the Cyber Security Office.


Key responsibilities:

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:


  • Set the multi-year strategy for Technology Risk & Compliance Business Partners - GSC & OT and secure the investment to deliver it.
  • Drive a risk-accountable leadership culture and a cyber- and risk-savvy workforce culture in Global Supply Chain and Operational Technology.
  • Lead the Technology Risk & Compliance Business Partners - GSC & OT organisation, including leaders of teams, and own its capability plan.
  • Own the budget, vendor portfolio and headcount plan for the capability.
  • Represent the capability to the CISO, GSK Tech leadership, auditors and regulators, including supporting risk and compliance for Sarbanes Oxley, Privacy regulations and Anti-Bribery and Corruption.
  • Own the cyber risk and compliance relationship for the assigned area, Global Supply Chain and Operational Technology, including manufacturing and laboratory systems.
  • Identify, analyse and influence the management of cyber security risk across the assigned area.
  • Hold operational areas, risk owners and suppliers to account against the Cyber Security Office strategy for the assigned area.
  • Build and maintain the cyber risk register for the area, including risk statements, ratings, owners and treatment plans.
  • Develop a deep understanding of Global Supply Chain business processes, including planning, manufacturing, distribution and quality, and supporting Information Technology and Operational Technology including ERP and integrated ecosystems, Manufacturing Execution Systems, Warehouse Management Systems, SCADA and industrial control systems.
  • Guide Global Supply Chain leadership on how the changing technology, threat and regulatory landscapes affect their risk posture and influence priorities, investments and roadmaps accordingly.
  • Own the Risk & Compliance governance forum (RMCB) for the assigned area, ensuring priority actions, findings and CAPAs are tracked with clear accountabilities.
  • Partner with Business Quality Assurance to ensure GxP validation of business-facing application systems and services within the assigned area.
  • Provide oversight and coaching to the team on audit and inspection readiness, including hosting of external inspections and regulator/auditor engagements, and on the reporting of CAPA status.
  • Provide oversight and coaching to the team on GxP software change management and system release governance for regulated applications within the assigned area.
  • Influence across the Cyber Security Office and broader Digital and Tech organisation to identify and shape solutions for effective and efficient risk and compliance management.
  • Lead your team in using approved AI tools to improve productivity and ways of working, role-modelling responsible use and follow GSK’s Responsible AI, privacy and security requirements

Why You?
Basic Qualification
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals:

  • Degree in a relevant discipline, or related experience.
  • Experience in cyber risk, technology risk or information security governance.
  • Experience with risk assessment and risk register management.
  • Experience engaging with senior business stakeholders.
  • Experience in cyber security, including leading a global capability at scale.
  • Experience leading leaders of teams across multiple geographies.
  • Experience owning a capability budget and vendor portfolio.
  • Experience influencing and communicating at executive and board level.
  • Experience with service definition and process improvement methodologies

Preferred Qualification
If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus:

  • Experience acting as a business information security officer or embedded security partner.
  • Working knowledge of NIST CSF, ISO 27001 and ISO 22301.
  • Experience with GRC platforms such as ServiceNow.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical or another regulated industry, including GxP and SOX contexts.
  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Relevant certification such as CISM, CRISC, CISA, CISSP.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences or another highly regulated industry.
  • Understanding of Operational Technology (OT) security concepts, applied across manufacturing, distribution, quality laboratory and supply chain environments.

Typical tools and technologies: ServiceNow GRC, Power BI

#AGTech

Skills

Cloud Security, Cybersecurity, Data Integrity, Executive Reports, Identity Access Management (IAM), Risk Assessments, Risk Management, Risk Management Framework, Security Architecture Design, Security Compliance, Security Policies, Security Risk, Third Party Risk Management, Vulnerability Management, Web Application SecurityThe US annual base salary for new hires in this position ranges from $195,000 to $325,000. The US salary ranges take into account a number of factors including work location within the US market, the candidate’s skills, experience, education level and the market rate for the role. In addition, this position offers an annual bonus and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program which is dependent on the level of the role. Available benefits include health care and other insurance benefits (for employee and family), retirement benefits, paid holidays, vacation, and paid caregiver/parental and medical leave. If salary ranges are not displayed in the job posting for a specific country, the relevant compensation will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Please visit GSK US Benefits Summary to learn more about the comprehensive benefits program GSK offers US employees.

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

Overview

We are looking for seasoned Data Engineer to work with our team and our clients to develop enterprise grade data platforms, services, and pipelines. We are looking for more than just a "Data Engineer", but a technologist with excellent communication and customer service skills and a passion for data and problem solving.

Contributions

  • Lead and architect migration of data environments with performance and reliability.
  • Assess and understand the ETL jobs, workflows, BI tools, and reports
  • Address technical inquiries concerning customization, integration, enterprise architecture and general feature / functionality of data products
  • Experience in crafting database / data warehouse solutions in cloud (Preferably AWS. Alternatively Azure, GCP).

  • Support an Agile software development lifecycle
  • You will contribute to the growth of our Data Exploitation Practice!

Qualifications

  • Ability to hold a position of public trust with the US government.
  • 2-4 years industry experience coding commercial software and a passion for solving complex problems.

  • Experience with data modeling tools and process
  • Experience architecting data systems (transactional and warehouses)
  • Experience aggregating results and/or compiling information for reporting from multiple datasets

Descripción

DIRECTOR/A COMERCIAL BILINGÜE | SEGUROS Y NEGOCIOS INTERNACIONALES | BOGOTÁ

En ACIERTA HEADHUNTER lideramos esta búsqueda para una compañía internacional del sector asegurador, con operación regional y una propuesta de valor especializada para clientes corporativos.

¿Te interesa asumir la dirección comercial de una organización con alcance internacional, fortalecer un equipo de alto desempeño y convertir la estrategia en crecimiento rentable, fidelización y nuevas oportunidades de negocio?

Revisa el perfil completo y aplica o compártelo con profesionales del sector asegurador

DESCRIPCIÓN GENERAL
Buscamos un/a Director/a Comercial Bilingüe para liderar la estrategia de crecimiento de una compañía del sector asegurador con cobertura internacional.

Esta posición tendrá la responsabilidad de organizar, desarrollar y movilizar al equipo comercial, integrado por Key Account Managers, comisionistas y profesionales freelance, asegurando una gestión disciplinada del pipeline, el cumplimiento de objetivos y la construcción de relaciones sostenibles con clientes corporativos.

El reto va más allá de supervisar ventas. Buscamos una persona capaz de interpretar las necesidades del mercado, conectar las áreas comercial y técnica, fortalecer la propuesta de valor y tomar decisiones que impulsen la rentabilidad, la fidelización y la expansión del negocio.

Es una oportunidad para un/a líder con visión internacional, criterio comercial y capacidad para convertir relaciones estratégicas en resultados medibles.

Requisitos

FORMACIÓN ACADÉMICA
Profesional en Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería Industrial, Negocios Internacionales, Comercio Exterior, Economía, Mercadeo o carreras afines.

Se valorará especialización en Dirección Comercial, Gerencia de Ventas, Seguros, Negocios Internacionales o áreas relacionadas.

La especialización podrá homologarse con experiencia relevante y comprobable dentro del sector asegurador.

Inglés avanzado C1 o superior, indispensable para interactuar con clientes, aliados y equipos internacionales.

Conocimientos de Excel y Power BI son importantes.

EXPERIENCIA Y CONOCIMIENTOS
Mínimo 6 años de experiencia profesional en áreas comerciales, desarrollo de negocios o gestión de cuentas corporativas.

Al menos 3 años liderando equipos comerciales o desempeñándose en posiciones de coordinación, dirección o gerencia.

Experiencia comprobable en el sector asegurador, reasegurador, corretaje de seguros, riesgos corporativos o servicios financieros relacionados.

Se valorará experiencia en negocios vinculados con logística, comercio exterior, transporte terrestre, aéreo o marítimo.

Experiencia liderando Key Account Managers, ejecutivos comerciales, comisionistas, canales externos o equipos independientes.

Conocimiento de venta consultiva B2B, negociación de alto nivel y desarrollo de cuentas estratégicas.

Capacidad para comprender coberturas, riesgos y necesidades del cliente, articulando soluciones con el área técnica.

Experiencia en planeación comercial, presupuestos, forecast, pipeline, indicadores y seguimiento de productividad.

Conocimiento en fidelización, renovación de cuentas y crecimiento del portafolio por cliente.

Manejo de CRM y plataformas digitales para seguimiento comercial.

Conocimiento general de sistemas de gestión de calidad y seguridad y salud en el trabajo.

RESPONSABILIDADES CLAVE
Diseñar e implementar la estrategia comercial de la compañía, alineada con los objetivos de crecimiento, rentabilidad y expansión internacional.

Liderar, organizar y desarrollar al equipo comercial, asegurando claridad en metas, segmentos, responsabilidades y prioridades.

Fortalecer la gestión de Key Account Managers, comisionistas y profesionales freelance.

Impulsar la captación de nuevos clientes corporativos y el crecimiento de las cuentas existentes.

Asegurar una gestión rigurosa del pipeline, forecast y oportunidades comerciales.

Coordinar con el área técnica la construcción de soluciones aseguradoras acordes con los riesgos y necesidades de los clientes.

Liderar las negociaciones estratégicas y acompañar los procesos comerciales de mayor impacto.

Diseñar iniciativas de fidelización, renovación y venta cruzada.

Presentar resultados, riesgos, proyecciones y recomendaciones a la gerencia.

Representar comercialmente a la compañía ante clientes, aliados y actores relevantes del mercado.

FUNCIONES PRINCIPALES
Construir el plan comercial anual y traducirlo en objetivos concretos por canal, segmento y responsable.

Definir territorios, cuentas objetivo, prioridades y estrategias de abordaje.

Liderar reuniones de seguimiento, comités comerciales y sesiones de revisión de resultados.

Acompañar al equipo en negociaciones complejas, presentaciones ejecutivas y cierres estratégicos.

Analizar el desempeño comercial y tomar acciones frente a desviaciones en presupuesto, conversión o productividad.

Desarrollar planes de formación, entrenamiento y acompañamiento para la fuerza de ventas.

Diseñar y administrar esquemas de incentivos alineados con crecimiento, margen y calidad de la cartera.

Evaluar riesgos comerciales y coordinar con el equipo técnico la estructuración de propuestas.

Hacer seguimiento a renovaciones, oportunidades de venta cruzada y potencial de crecimiento por cliente.

Promover el uso disciplinado del CRM y la actualización permanente de la información comercial.

Preparar informes ejecutivos sobre ventas, forecast, pipeline, actividad y resultados.

Participar en la selección y vinculación de nuevos integrantes del equipo comercial.

Identificar tendencias del mercado, movimientos de la competencia y nuevas oportunidades de negocio.

Asegurar el cumplimiento de políticas internas, lineamientos de calidad y disposiciones de seguridad y salud en el trabajo.

COMPETENCIAS CLAVE
Visión estratégica: para anticipar oportunidades, interpretar el mercado y definir caminos de crecimiento.

Liderazgo comercial: indispensable para movilizar equipos diversos hacia objetivos comunes.

Orientación a resultados: para mantener el foco en cumplimiento, rentabilidad y expansión.

Negociación e influencia: necesarias para gestionar clientes corporativos, aliados y decisiones de alto impacto.

Comunicación ejecutiva: clave para interactuar con equipos internacionales, áreas técnicas y alta dirección.

Toma de decisiones: para priorizar oportunidades, ajustar estrategias y actuar frente a desviaciones.

Pensamiento analítico: importante para interpretar indicadores, riesgos, productividad y desempeño comercial.

Desarrollo de equipos: fundamental para elevar capacidades, autonomía y nivel de ejecución.

Resiliencia: necesaria para sostener el desempeño en ciclos comerciales exigentes.

Trabajo transversal: esencial para conectar comercial, técnico, operaciones y gerencia.

Orientación al cliente: para construir relaciones de confianza y soluciones de largo plazo.

Integridad: indispensable en la gestión de información, condiciones comerciales y relaciones institucionales.

Beneficios

OPORTUNIDAD Y BENEFICIOS
Posición estratégica con exposición directa a la alta dirección.

Remuneración competitiva.

Esquema de comisiones y bonificaciones por desempeño.

Contrato laboral con condiciones acordes con el nivel del cargo.

Acceso a formación continua en seguros, normatividad, estrategias comerciales y liderazgo.

Participación en una operación con alcance internacional.

Oportunidades de crecimiento y desarrollo dentro de la organización.

Cultura orientada al servicio, la innovación y el cumplimiento de objetivos.

Herramientas tecnológicas para la gestión comercial y el análisis de riesgos.

Programas de bienestar y cumplimiento de las disposiciones de seguridad y salud en el trabajo.

Esta oportunidad está dirigida a líderes comerciales con experiencia en seguros, capacidad para desarrollar equipos y criterio para conducir negociaciones corporativas en contextos internacionales.

Buscamos una persona que no solo administre una fuerza de ventas, sino que fortalezca su nivel de ejecución, identifique nuevas oportunidades y convierta la estrategia comercial en relaciones sostenibles y resultados rentables.

Aplicar directamente en esta oferta es la mejor forma de hacernos llegar tu hoja de vida y tenerla en cuenta para este proceso.

raw.description:
FULL-STACK ENGINEER

RESPONSIBILITY

The Full Stack Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining scalable, high-performance, and secure web applications. The role requires expertise in frontend and backend development, cloud technologies, DevOps automation, and application security. Engineers must work in an agile, DevOps-driven environment, ensuring high software quality, security, and maintainability.

  • Take full ownership of end-to-end application development, integrating frontend, backend, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Design, develop, and maintain responsive, accessible, and performant web applications.
  • Implement modern frontend architectures, ensuring reusability, scalability, and security.
  • Develop high-performance backend services and APIs, ensuring reliability, security, and observability.
  • Work with Quality Assurance (QA) engineers to ensure automated test coverage and proactively fix bugs and defects.
  • Optimize full-stack CI/CD deployment strategies, ensuring seamless and automated releases.
  • Work with DevOps teams to automate infrastructure provisioning, monitoring, and cloud deployments.
  • Ensure full-stack security, including authentication, authorization, API security, and frontend security best practices.
  • Continuously evaluate and adopt emerging technologies to improve application performance and developer productivity.

EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS NEEDED

Full Stack Development:

  • Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Computer or Electronics Engineering, Information Technology, or related disciplines.
  • Experience with Git and modern branching workflows (GitFlow, trunk-based development).
  • Strong proficiency in both frontend and backend development.

Frontend Technologies:

  • JavaScript and TypeScript.
  • Frontend frameworks such as React.js, Next.js, Vue.js, Angular, or Svelte.
  • Mobile app development using Swift (iOS), Kotlin (Android), or React Native.
  • UI component libraries such as Material-UI, Tailwind CSS, or Bootstrap.

Employee Applicant Privacy Notice

Who we are:

Shape a brighter financial future with us.

Together with our members, we’re changing the way people think about and interact with personal finance.

The industry is going through an unprecedented transformation, and we’re at the forefront. We’re proud to come to work every day knowing that what we do has a direct impact on people’s lives, with our core values guiding us every step of the way. Join us to invest in yourself, your career, and the financial world.

Retail Production Assistant

SoFi is seeking a proactive, high-energy Production Assistant to serve as the backbone for our top-producing Retail Mortgage Loan Originators (MLOs). In this role, you aren’t just a support player; you are the engine that keeps the loan origination process moving.

You’ll act as the primary bridge between borrowers, realtors, and our internal operations team, ensuring every file is structured for success from day one. If you are detail-focused, tech-savvy, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we want to talk to you.

What You’ll Do

  • Business Development & Retention: Develop and execute targeted marketing strategies to engage the existing book of business for client retention, while proactively building relationships with prospective clients and key centers of influence to drive new-to-bank growth.
  • Loan Structuring & Analysis: Pull and analyze credit reports, review income/asset documentation, and assist MLOs in determining the optimal loan structure for clients.
  • Pipeline Management: Run Desktop Underwriter (DU), stack files for submission, and proactively request/clear underwriting conditions to ensure "on-time" closings.
  • Client Advocacy: Serve as the primary point of contact for borrowers and realtors, providing status updates and maintaining a seamless white-glove experience.
  • Front-End Support: Take initial application information over the phone, schedule high-priority appointments, and manage MLO calendars.
  • Data Integrity: Track all document requests in Encompass and Salesforce. Review incoming files within 24 hours to catch discrepancies, omissions, or income/asset issues before they hit underwriting.
  • Problem Solving: Collaborate directly with MLOs and Underwriters to resolve complex file issues and documentation gaps.
  • Compliance: Maintain strict adherence to company policy and state/federal regulatory guidelines (RESPA, TILA, etc.) to ensure every file is audit-ready.

What You’ll Need

  • Experience: At least 2 years of professional office experience, with a minimum of 1 year specifically in the mortgage or banking industry.
  • Strategic Mindset: Proven ability to manage client relationships and execute marketing initiatives aimed at both retention and new lead generation.
  • Technical Knowledge: General fluency in FNMA, FHLMC, FHA, and VA guidelines.
  • Tech Stack: Previous experience with Encompass LOS (or similar mortgage software) and proficiency in Google Workspace.
  • Precision: An uncompromising eye for detail and the ability to juggle a high-volume pipeline.
  • Communication: Elite verbal and written communication skills—you’ll be representing SoFi to clients and external partners daily.

Nice to Have

  • Advanced Tools: Direct experience with Blend and/or Salesforce.
  • Origination Background: 1+ years of experience as a Loan Originator or Senior Processor.
  • Licensing Multiplier: National and multi-state NMLS licensing maintained within the past 12 months.

Business Analyst / Project Manager

Overview

We are recruiting on behalf of our client for a Business Analyst / Project Manager. Our client is a UK-based consultancy that works with small business owners to map, measure, and improve how their businesses operate. This role sits at the centre of every client engagement — managing projects through a structured five-stage methodology whilst maintaining the day-to-day client relationship from first conversation through to ongoing support.

The successful candidate will split their time between project management and hands-on business analysis, running process-mapping workshops with business owners and ensuring that nothing falls through the cracks across multiple concurrent engagements. This is a fully remote position requiring alignment with UK business hours (GMT/BST).

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage multiple client projects simultaneously, tracking the status of each engagement and identifying what is progressing, what is blocked, and what needs immediate attention
  • Own the client relationship day to day — serve as the primary point of contact, communicate progress clearly and honestly, and set realistic expectations on timing and effort
  • Build and maintain detailed project plans and Gantt charts, keeping them accurate as scope, priorities, and deadlines evolve
  • Facilitate workshops and one-to-one sessions with business owners to map end-to-end business processes, producing activity diagrams and flow charts in Miro using standard UML notation
  • Co-ordinate actions, dependencies, and outstanding information across clients, consultants, bookkeepers, and management accountants — chasing what is overdue before it causes delay
  • Identify gaps, bottlenecks, and risks early, raising concerns proactively with the client and the internal team rather than waiting to be asked
  • Maintain clear records of decisions, actions, and owners after every client interaction, and keep overall project status visible to the wider team at all times

Requirements

  • Matric (Grade 12) as a minimum; a BCom, National Diploma in Business Administration, or a relevant NQF Level 6–7 qualification is strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated experience in a business analysis role, including requirements elicitation, process documentation, and assumption testing
  • Hands-on project management experience running several projects concurrently, with a track record of delivering on time and communicating clearly when timelines change
  • Proficiency in Miro or a comparable online whiteboard tool, alongside everyday collaboration tools such as task trackers, shared documents, and spreadsheets
  • Confident working directly with clients or external stakeholders, ideally owners or senior leaders of small to medium-sized businesses
  • Comfortable reading and discussing basic financial information — P&L statements, cash flow, and business performance figures — without needing to be a qualified accountant

Preferred Experience

  • Prior exposure to financial services, accountancy practice, consulting, or finance operations
  • Familiarity with Xero or similar cloud-based accounting software
  • Experience supporting SMEs in sectors such as construction, e-commerce, or professional services
  • A recognised qualification in project management or business analysis, such as PRINCE2, PMP, or a BABOK-aligned certification

Key Competencies

* Strong communication skills

* High attention to detail

* Strong organisational skills

* Ability to work independently

* Professionalism and reliability

Overview

We're looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer with expertise across the frontend (React, TypeScript, CSS, HTML) and backend (Node.js, Express.js, OpenAPI, relational databases) stack to join our app team. Working closely with product owners, designers, and fellow engineers, you'll iterate quickly on features, improve performance, and build out a secure, scalable platform for real-world military and government users. This role focuses on hands-on coding and software design, spanning everything from UI workflows to API development to database architecture. This role requires an active Secret security clearance.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

 

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

 

Our team is laser-focused on building a unified, real-time common operating picture fusing asset data, threat information, terrain, routes, and protection effects. If you’re ready to dive in, take ownership, and ship real value, keep reading.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Write quality software, participate in code reviews, and help develop best practices and documentation.
  • Support full-stack systems design decisions involving API architecture, data models, and UI component structure.
  • Embrace AI-drive development, building the guardrails, validation layers, end-to-end tests, and supporting systems that keep AI-assisted output safe, reliable, and production-grade.
  • Build intuitive, responsive front-end experiences using React and modern component libraries, translating requirements into clean, reusable UI components.
  • Write clean, secure back-end services using Express.js, with a focus on REST APIs, modular design, and Prisma ORM.
  • Collaborate across design, product, DevSecOps, and field teams to launch features quickly and securely.
  • Support automated testing and code quality gates by writing and reviewing unit, integration, and end-to-end tests.
  • Troubleshoot bugs, squash performance bottlenecks, and build for IL6 deployment requirements.

Qualifications

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of relevant software engineering experience.
  • Demonstrated expertise in full stack software development.
  • Experience using AI-enabled development tools to rapidly ship software.
  • Strong frontend skills: React (component design, hooks, modern front-end patterns), JavaScript/TypeScript, and a solid grasp of HTML, CSS, and responsive design principles.
  • Strong backend skills: Express.JS, with hands-on experience with Prisma ORM and relational databases, plus a solid understanding of SQL, indexing, and query optimization.
  • Experience with testing tools across the stack (e.g., Jest, Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright, Cypress) and a track record of building automated validation and end-to-end testing into delivery.
  • Familiarity with secure software development practices and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab, etc).
  • Comfortable with Agile/Lean, rapid delivery cycles, and direct user feedback loops.

Bonus Points For:

  • Hands-on work with secure government environments (DoD, IL5+, FedRAMP).
  • Experience building geospatial applications.
  • Certifications like Security+ and AWS Developer/Architect.
  • Past experience at a startup or in rapid-growth teams.

Marketing Manager

Location: Home Based

Department: Marketing

Contract type: Permanent / Full-time

About the role

We’re looking for a Marketing Manager to join our Marketing team!

The Marketing Manager is responsible for positioning and communicating the sopp+sopp proposition, and for developing and delivering the go-to-market strategy that supports our sales and business development growth plans.

This is a hands-on role for a commercially minded marketer who can both set the strategy and deliver it. With a strong understanding of B2B marketing strategy, market research, sales enablement, digital marketing and content creation, they will use Claude and other intelligent tools to plan, research, produce and analyse work at pace, driving engagement and visibility across all channels.

Reporting to the Business Development Director, they will be the key marketing stakeholder for the sopp+sopp leadership team, developing plans based on business priorities and being prepared to challenge the status quo. They will work closely with the Activate Group central marketing team, led by Kate Rooney, Head of Marketing and Communications, which provides design support and manages awards entries across the group.

Activate Group is a growing UK business with 1,000+ team members nationwide. This is an exciting opportunity to build a long-term career with a company that values its people and offers genuine development and progression opportunities.

Key responsibilities

  • Build and deliver the sopp+sopp marketing strategy and plan, aligned to sales targets and business development priorities, across all market-facing channels
  • Research and develop propositions for new markets, sectors and channels, building market intelligence on customers, competitors and industry trends to inform strategy
  • Plan and propose the marketing budget, ensure it aligns with business goals, and track spend and return on investment
  • Work closely with the sales and business development team to generate and nurture leads, and support core sales activity including significant bids and tenders, sales collateral and events
  • Plan, write and produce content for websites, blogs, case studies, slide decks, emails, social platforms and publication partners, on time and to a consistently high quality
  • Use Claude and other intelligent tools to research, create and analyse content efficiently, and keep up to date with new tools that improve how marketing is delivered
  • Help colleagues across sopp+sopp get the most from these tools by sharing good practice and practical guidance
  • Lead the digital marketing approach, including SEO best practice, paid promotional activity, email and social, to grow visibility across key digital channels
  • Measure and report on marketing performance, including lead generation, pipeline contribution and content engagement, and use the data to improve results
  • Work in partnership with the Activate Group central marketing team, providing clear briefs to the group designer for visual media and supplying sopp+sopp input for awards entries managed centrally
  • Ensure all collateral (e.g., infographics, slide decks, video, website, email layouts) meets Activate Group brand guidelines and is relevant to the target audience
  • Contribute to group marketing strategy and shared ways of working alongside the central marketing team
  • Plan and deliver external campaigns, including events, publication partnerships and targeted campaigns, and liaise with external suppliers of photography, video, exhibition and promotional material

Skills and experience

Essential:

  • At least five years of experience in B2B marketing, covering proposition or product marketing, digital marketing and content creation
  • Ability to create a marketing strategy and do the hands-on work to deliver it
  • Ability to define value propositions for services and solutions
  • Experience of market research and turning insight into practical marketing plans
  • Confident, practical user of Claude or similar intelligent writing, research and analysis tools, with the curiosity to find and test new ones
  • In-depth knowledge of digital marketing channels, including SEO, social media, email marketing and PPC advertising, to drive online visibility and engagement
  • Strong analytical skills to measure and assess the performance of marketing initiatives
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience of creating content from scratch - planning, researching and engaging with stakeholders to understand and deliver quality content
  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks, deadlines and stakeholders independently

Desirable:

  • Experience in fleet, motor insurance, automotive or a related B2B services sector

Benefits

We believe in rewarding our people for the great work they do. When you join Activate Group, you can expect:

•33 days holiday, including bank holidays

•Personal health cash plan – claim back the cost of everyday healthcare such as dental and optical check-ups

•Enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental pay

•Life assurance at three times your basic salary

•Free breakfasts and fresh fruit

•A birthday surprise for everyone

What you can expect from us

At Activate Group, we want everyone to have the tools and support they need to do their best work. We’re an innovative business that continuously reviews and improves our systems, processes and ways of working, making sure they support our teams to do their jobs effectively.

Every role at Activate Group is aligned to our wider business vision and purpose – making someone’s bad day better. You’ll understand how your role contributes to the bigger picture and how your work helps deliver excellent outcomes for customer and partners.

We believe work should be enjoyable. We make time to celebrate success, recognise achievements and bring people together at team events and company-wide celebrations. We’ll also support your ongoing development through regular feedback and career planning.

Whether you’re based in one of our contact centres in Halifax, Peterborough or Huddersfield, working at an Activate Accident Repair (AAR) site, or working from home, you’ll be part of a supportive culture where people are encouraged to succeed.

A bit about us

Activate Group is a fast-growing business approaching 1,000 team members nationwide.

We work with some of the UK’s largest fleets and insurance companies, supporting drivers that have been involved in road incidents through our contact centres in Halifax, Peterborough and Huddersfield.

We manage every step of the repair journey - repairing vehicles at our own Activate Accident Repair (AAR) body shops, as well as through a UK-wide network of trusted independent repair partners.

We also work with the UK’s largest vehicle manufacturers, supporting their approved repair programmes, and deliver innovative technology solutions to fleets, vehicle repair centres and dealerships.

Our purpose & values

Our purpose underpins everything we do: Make someone’s bad day better

Our values define how we work with our team members, customers and suppliers:

•Make it happen – Be accountable. Take the initiative, work fast, and do a great job.

•Strive for better– Be bold. Challenge the norm - make small improvements often.

• Win together– Be a team player. Win together, learn together, respect each other.

Salary: £40,000 – £45,000 / year

ELESSAR SYSTEMS INC.

Training. Left of Launch.

POSITION DESCRIPTION

Chief Executive Officer

Founding executive of a new defense technology company commercializing Q2 Holodeck™, an immersive training platform for unmanned aircraft systems (UAS) and counter-UAS (C-UAS) decision-making.

POSITION Chief Executive Officer (Co-Founder)

COMPANY Elessar Systems Inc. (Q2 Holodeck™ training platform)

REPORTS TO Board of Directors

DIRECT REPORTS Chief Technology Officer; Chief of Staff; Chief Operating Officer, Director of Business Development; future CRO, CFO/Controller, and Head of Delivery

LOCATION Remote

EMPLOYMENT TYPE Full-time, exempt

Position Summary

The Chief Executive Officer is a co-founder and principal of Elessar Systems Inc., holds full profit-and-loss accountability, and reports to the Board of Directors. The CEO sets the company’s strategy, raises capital, leads government go-to-market, and builds the team to execute on that strategy. In the first eighteen months, the CEO will personally lead customer pursuits, fundraising, and pricing decisions and will be accountable for the company’s first major contract awards.

About Elessar

Elessar is a newly formed defense technology company commercializing Q2 Holodeck™, a browser-based, AI/ML-driven, scenario-based training platform that trains security, force protection, and first-responder personnel to identify a drone, select a lawful and effective response, and report the incident before a real event occurs. The platform runs on The Makusudi Game™, a patented decision-training methodology incubated at Q2IMPACT™, and scores each decision against the authorities and rules of engagement applicable to the customer’s site.

Q2 Holodeck™ is offered as a hosted SaaS, with dedicated and customer-hosted deployments available, subject to technical validation. It serves DoD and DOE/NNSA protective forces, federal and SLTT law enforcement, critical-infrastructure operators, corrections, private entities, and allied nations. As a software product, it enables thousands of personnel to train simultaneously, without the classroom, range, and instructor constraints of traditional schoolhouse training. The market is still early, and the CEO will have the opportunity to set the training standard for AI/ML-driven, dynamic, decision-based training capabilities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (approximate % of time)

Ø Strategy and Commercial Model (15%). Set the company’s strategy and market-entry sequence across federal, state and local, and critical-infrastructure markets; finalize pricing and packaging for all deployment modes; protect and extend the company’s intellectual property; and position Q2 Holodeck™ as the reference standard for C-UAS decision training.

Ø Capital Formation and Finance (20%). Lead equity fundraising; pursue non-dilutive funding, including SBIR/STTR, OTA, and program-office awards; own the budget, burn rate, and runway; and establish the finance, accounting, and contract-cost infrastructure required to scale.

Ø Business Development and Capture (30%). Own revenue, pipeline, and forecast; personally lead early-stage pursuits and close reference customers; establish repeatable contracting pathways (CRADA, government purchase card, sole source, and OTA); convert demonstrations into awards; and build relationships with partners and prime contractors.

Ø Product and Delivery Oversight (10%). Set roadmap priorities with the CTO; clearly distinguish fielded and planned capabilities in all external communications; turn custom scenario development into a repeatable process; and build delivery, support, and training-effectiveness measures that drive renewals.

Ø Organization and Talent (10%). Recruit revenue, finance, and delivery leadership ahead of need; build the founding team; and set the company's culture, planning cadence, and accountability standards.

Ø Governance, Compliance, and Risk (10%). Report accurately and promptly to the Board; ensure compliance with ISO 27001, FedRAMP or equivalent authorizations, export controls (ITAR and EAR), and security requirements; manage concentration, accreditation, key-person, and IP risks; and enforce ethical standards in government or commercial sales.

Ø External Representation (5%). Serve as the company’s principal spokesperson to customers, agency and congressional leadership, industry, media, and investors, and contribute to the policy debate on C-UAS authorities and training standards.

Key Performance Objectives

The Board expects the following outcomes over the first twenty-four months. The CEO will set specific targets at the time of hire, and the Board will review them quarterly.

OBJECTIVE HOW SUCCESS IS MEASURED HORIZON

Capital formation Priced round or non-dilutive award closed, funding at least eighteen months of runway against a credible plan Months 1–9

First revenue Signed multi-seat agreements, including at least one named reference customer willing to speak publicly Months 3–12

Contract vehicles At least one executed CRADA, OTA, or sole-source award, with a documented, repeatable path for follow-on work with government and private-sector customers Months 6–15

Compliance and delivery Progress toward ISO 27001, CMMC 2.0, and FedRAMP certification, including a GCC High environment accredited for CUI Months 6–24

Team and pipeline Revenue, finance, and delivery leadership hired; qualified pipeline covering the following year’s plan Months 1–24

Requirements

Qualifications

Required

Ø Education. Bachelor’s degree required.

Ø Experience. Fifteen or more years of progressively senior leadership, including at least five years as a CEO, general manager, division president, or other executive with profit-and-loss responsibility.

Ø Growth record. Demonstrated success scaling a technology, services, products, or software business from early revenue to a durable commercial model, including ownership of pricing and go-to-market strategy.

Ø Market exposure. Direct experience selling to or delivering for U.S. federal, defense, public safety, critical infrastructure, or business-to-business customers.

Ø Capital formation. Experience leading or advising on capital raises (venture, strategic, or non-dilutive) or on mergers and acquisitions.

Ø Financial acumen, including budgeting, cash management, unit economics, and the fiduciary and governance obligations of a company officer.

Ø Work authorization. Eligible to work in the United States.

Ø Travel. Able to travel approximately 25–30% for customer demonstrations, agency engagements, industry events, and investor meetings.

Preferred

Ø Advanced degree in business, engineering, national security, public policy, STEM, or a related field.

Ø Background in counter-UAS, air defense, force protection, homeland security, or critical infrastructure protection.

Ø Experience delivering or implementing SaaS solutions.

Ø Familiarity with the DoD Planning, Programming, Budgeting, and Execution (PPBE) process.

Ø A record of taking a company from pre-revenue to a recurring-revenue sales pipeline.

Benefits

Compensation and Benefits

Ø Base salary of USD 200,000-250,000 per year, based on experience and the company’s capital position at the time of hire.

Ø Performance bonus. A milestone-based bonus of 25% to 50% of base salary is paid upon achievement of the Board-approved objectives above, such as closing the first funding round or securing the first contract award.

Ø Equity. Founder-level equity of 10% to 15%, vesting over four years with a one-year cliff and acceleration upon a qualifying change of control.

Ø Benefits. Medical, dental, and vision coverage; 401(k) with matching; unlimited paid time off; and clearance-related and professional expenses.

Equal Employment Opportunity: Elessar, a subsidiary of Q2IMPACT™, is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, marital status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Reasonable accommodations are available to applicants and employees with disabilities upon request.

Money is moving onto the internet, and the shift has a name: Open Money. This is money that is open, portable, agentic, and owned by you. MetaMask spent the last ten years building it; with 100M+ downloads, users in ~190 countries, and trillions in cumulative transaction volume, it's the most trusted self-custodial financial platform on the internet. Now we're building the operating system for your money: one place to hold, move, grow, and use anything you own. Join a remote-first, global team rebuilding how money works: a problem that touches everyone, every day.

About the role

MetaMask is the world's leading self-custodial wallet — and the primary gateway for hundreds of millions of people into the onchain economy. Our Trading features sit at the heart of that experience: enabling users to place a swap, a perp trade, a prediction market trade, or an investment in Real-World-Assets (RWA) with confidence.

We're looking for a strategic, data-informed, and user-obsessed Senior Product Marketing Manager to own the positioning and growth of these features. This is one of the highest-leverage roles in the MetaMask marketing organisation — sitting at the intersection of product strategy, go-to-market execution, and long-term brand trust.

You'll report to our Product Marketing Director and work across Product, Growth, Brand, Business Development, and Partner Marketing to ensure every launch and lifecycle initiative is anchored in insight, competitive differentiation, and measurable impact.

What you'll do

Strategy

  • Define and execute end-to-end GTM strategy for features within Trading across global markets — from opportunity sizing and positioning through to launch and lifecycle optimisation
  • Partner with Product leads to shape roadmap priorities based on market insight, user behaviour, and growth potential
  • Act as a strategic thought partner to Product and Growth, representing user needs and market realities in decision-making
  • Influence long-term product strategy and monetisation through competitive analysis, segmentation, and market research

GTM and product growth

  • Lead product and feature launches, crafting narratives that resonate with crypto traders and holders,
  • Drive lifecycle marketing initiatives that increase awareness, activation, and retention across Trading funnels
  • Partner with Growth and Analytics to identify friction points and opportunities within user journeys, translating insights into programmes that move key metrics — conversion, volume, retention
  • Ensure strong measurement and continuous iteration — every campaign should have clear success metrics and documented learnings

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Collaborate with Product, Brand, Growth, Communications, Business Development, and Customer Support to deliver integrated campaigns that connect product value to cultural relevance
  • Align cross-functional stakeholders and manage timelines, priorities, and expectations to ensure seamless execution
  • Partner with Data and Product to monitor performance, share learnings, and continually refine GTM approaches

Brand and community

  • Strengthen MetaMask's reputation as a trusted, user-first brand in the Trading community
  • Support education, community, and influencer programmes that drive awareness and confidence — particularly among emerging market segments
  • Ensure consistency in storytelling across all surfaces, from lifecycle emails to content and brand campaigns

What you'll bring

  • 6 to 8+ years in product marketing, ideally within fintech, crypto, or a high-growth consumer tech environment

Background

We are looking for a Senior Generative AI Engineer to design, build, and ship production-grade Generative AI and Agentic AI applications that delivery business value across the organization. This role is focused on building AI applications and services at scale. You will be responsible for building robust, secure, and highly scalable systems that integrate with leading cloud-based AI services.

You will work alongside product managers, designers, and other engineers as an individual contributor. You are expected to own features end-to-end, and to deliver high-quality, reusable code that scales beyond a single use case.

Key Responsibilities

Software Engineering and Execution

  • Design, build, and ship production-grade Generative and Agentic AI features and applications
  • Own features end-to-end from technical design through implementation, testing, deployment and operation
  • Build reusable, well-abstracted components and shared utilities (e.g., RAG building blocks, agent scaffolding, evaluation harnesses, prompt utilities) to enable faster delivery of future Generative and Agentic AI products
  • Build multi-agent systems using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK and Google ADK
  • Integrate with leading LLM and foundation model APIs, including Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, and AWS Bedrock

  • Implement observability, tracing, evaluation, guardrails for Generative and Agentic AI applications

  • Participate actively in code reviews and design discussions, sharing knowledge with peers

Required Qualifications

  • 5-7 years of professional software engineering experience with at least 3 years of experience building AI/ML software products
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field (Master's degree preferred)
  • Strong proficiency in Python, with deep software engineering fundamentals (abstraction, modularity, system design, testing, performance)
  • Hands-on experience building and shipping Generative and Agentic AI applications, including LLM integration, prompt engineering, and/or agentic workflows
  • Practical experience integrating cloud-hosted LLM APIs such as Azure OpenAI, Vertex AI, and/or AWS Bedrock
  • Experience with agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, Claude Agent SDK) and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector, Open Search, AlloyDB)
  • Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or Azure
  • Solid understanding of API design, distributed systems, and cloud-native architecture
  • Track record of taking systems from design through production deployment and operation

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Knowledge of Generative AI Risk Management frameworks (NIST RFM)
  • Experience supporting developer platforms or internal tooling

raw.description:
JOB DETAIL


Job Purpose

  • Lead through technical support of drilling operations offshore and onshore. Plan, technically manage, and facilitate drilling activities that are fully aligned with the Group technical and SHE standards and provide fully qualified drilling engineering support for technically complex development projects. Progress projects from planning and concept selection through to engineering design and safe operational execution.

Job Context & Major Challenge(s) - I

  • The Completions and Workover programs are highly complex, involving challenging operations and a diverse mix of activity / well types. Some examples of the challenges include (1) multiple parallel projects with dynamic schedules, tight schedule constraints, and uncertainty in sequencing of rig activities; (2) diverse mix of activities and well designs (e.g., spare slot vs. new wellhead platforms, monobore vs. OBB well designs, standard vs. sub-horizontal (SHZ) well architecture; (3) brownfield work conducted among increasingly congested facilities and depleted reservoirs increasing risk and complexity; (4) complex interfaces among organizations and increasing requirements for planning and administration; (5) new wells in expansion areas are longer and more complex than historical wells; (6) coordination of 10+ rigs with changing contracting strategy may lead to additional new rig start-ups for any of the projects; (7) driving service quality from all service partners.

Key Job Accountabilities - I

  • Perform drilling analyses/calculations, provide drill well surveillance, and act as a focal point for continuous improvement by implementation of technology transfer and application of best practices.
  • Plan, develop and write drilling programs that include casing design, mud specifications, cementing, BHA and bit selection, hydraulics, wellheads, well control, and other drilling parameters.
  • Lead through technical support of drilling operations offshore and onshore.
  • Ensure wellbore and equipment integrity during drilling operations.
  • Lead the preparing of comprehensive drilling risk management strategies covering areas of safety & health, environmental impacts, emergency preparedness, well control procedures and relief well contingency plans.

Key Job Accountabilities - II

  • Support procurement activities (pre-qualifications, tendering process, and bid evaluations with focus on long lead-time and critical items (rigs, wellheads, casings, etc.).
  • Support QA/ QC activities (audits, technical reviews, inspections, specifications with focus on long lead-time and critical items (rigs, wellheads, casings, etc.).
  • Implement Monobore and Big Bore technology in conjunction with completions engineering and shareholder technical resources including wellheads, liners and related equipment.
  • Assist management in areas of performance measurement and continuous improvement through the facilitation of communication and teamwork.
  • Evaluate drilling and recommend effective modifications to enhance/improve the drilling process. Ensure drilling execution in line with intended plan.

Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree in Engineering.

Knowledge and/or Experience - I

  • +8 years relevant experience.
  • Experience providing stewardship of service contracts including (drilling rigs, offshore and onshore, drilling equipment, services, tangibles, and consumables). Experience with H2S well designs and safety practices ideally in Offshore Completions and Workover operations.
  • Specialized expertise level required for critical activities and work scope including (well control and well control equipment, perforating operations, acid stimulation design and operations, wireline operations, coiled tubing operations, wellhead, tree, and downhole equipment, pressure pumping operations, completion design and equipment, land rig and jack-up rig and barge operations, fishing and milling operations, H2S operations).

Technical and Business Skills - I

  • Well control proficiency.
  • Demonstrated competency in completions and workover engineering and operations commensurate with years of experience.
  • Commitment to safe and environmentally sound well construction.
  • Awareness of emerging drilling industry technology and capable of assessing new technology for implementation where appropriate.
  • Execution of competent and fully completed staff level technical designs meeting industry best practices and QG requirements.
  • Fluent in English (demonstrated verbal and written skills).
  • Demonstrated ability to use common PC software (MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Project) as well as functional specific software (such as Well View, Landmark Compass, WellCat, SAP etc.).

Cos'è Blox Space?

Blox Space lavora al centro dell'economia tech,in partnership con un network di oltre 70 realtà attive nel mondo dell'AI, del software, della cybersecurity e delle Freedom Technologies, impegnate nello sviluppo di infrastrutture, prodotti e servizi legati all'economia digitale, alla data protection e al futuro del denaro.
﻿Aiutiamo a connettere i talenti con questo ecosistema, operando come Talent Bridge tra le ambizioni di crescita dei professionisti e le opportunità offerte dal nostro network.
﻿In questo momento stiamo supportando una delle nostre partner companies nella ricerca di un LLM Fine-Tuning Engineer, e se pensi di essere il profilo giusto, ci piacerebbe conoscerti.

Il Ruolo

L'azienda è una startup di cybersecurity italiana che costruisce sistemi di sicurezza autonomi: individuano vulnerabilità sconosciute, prioritizzano il rischio reale e distribuiscono le correzioni senza intervento umano, con un focus sui binari compilati, perché è quello che gira davvero in produzione. È un team early, pre-seed, fondato da ricercatori di sicurezza e accademici di primo piano.
﻿Cerchiamo un LLM Fine-Tuning Engineer che adatti, valuti e metta in produzione modelli linguistici open-weight, ma piegati a un unico scopo: trovare e capire vulnerabilità. Per questo cerchiamo una persona fortemente orientata alla cybersecurity, che non si limiti ad addestrare modelli ma capisca il dominio su cui lavorano. Non è un ruolo di prompt engineering: è l'intero ciclo di post-training, dal design dei dataset al fine tuning, dalla generazione di dati sintetici alla valutazione, fino al deploy in ambienti locali, privati o ristretti.
﻿Non cerchiamo il curriculum perfetto, cerchiamo la testa giusta. Cerchiamo chi sa trasformare un foundation model in un sistema affidabile e specifico per il compito, sa quando il fine tuning è la strada giusta e quando invece conviene prompting, retrieval, orchestrazione o tooling, e porta con sé una vera sensibilità per il mindset di chi attacca.
﻿Le responsabilità di un LLM Fine-Tuning Engineer in questo contesto possono spaziare dal fine tuning e dall'adattamento di LLM open-weight per casi d'uso di sicurezza, interni o rivolti al cliente, al confronto tra approcci di post-training (SFT, tecniche parameter-efficient come LoRA e QLoRA, preference tuning come DPO dove serve, full fine tuning quando giustificato), dalla costruzione e pulizia di dataset di qualità e dalla generazione di dati sintetici alla definizione di metodi di valutazione che vanno oltre i benchmark generici, fino all'analisi di regressioni e failure mode e al lavoro con il team di engineering per servire i modelli in ambienti vincolati.

﻿﻿﻿

Le skill che fanno la differenza

  • Esperienza pratica vera nel fine tuning di LLM: in produzione, in ricerca applicata o in contesti sperimentali seri, con più tecniche di post-training alle spalle, idealmente SFT, LoRA e QLoRA.
  • Orientamento forte alla cybersecurity: capisci (o hai una gran voglia di capire a fondo) threat model, bug hunting e la logica di chi attacca. È il dominio su cui i modelli lavorano, e qui fa la differenza tra un buon fine tuning e uno inutile.
  • Dati prima di tutto: sai costruire, curare e mantenere dataset per training e valutazione, e sai generare, filtrare e validare dati sintetici per migliorare il comportamento del modello, non per gonfiare le metriche.
  • Stack solido: Python forte, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, tokenizzazione, preprocessing e training pipeline sono pane quotidiano.
  • Dimestichezza con i vincoli reali: limiti di GPU, trade-off memoria/performance, workflow quantization-aware e ottimizzazione del training.
  • Mentalità da debugging: sai capire perché un modello è migliorato, è regredito, ha fatto overfit o ha fallito, e la valutazione la imposti su quello che conta davvero a livello operativo, non sui punteggi generici.
  • Autonomia a cavallo tra ricerca, dati ed engineering: ti muovi da solo su tutti e tre i fronti.
  • Sono Very Nice to Have: un background in software security o vulnerability research, esperienza in CTF, deploy in ambienti air-gapped, on-premise o ristretti, inference optimization, quantization, model serving o runtime LLM locali, training distribuito o multi-GPU, eval harness, red-teaming o model safety testing.

Ti manca qualcosa rispetto a quello che hai letto? Candidati comunque: siamo a caccia di game-changer, non di checklist da spuntare!﻿

Work arrangements

Il ruolo ha come sede preferenziale l'hub di Blox Space a Torino, un ambiente cost-effective e ad alta densità di persone tecniche di valore, ma valutiamo candidature da tutta Italia, con modalità operative flessibili da concordare insieme al team.
﻿Per il ruolo è previsto un range retributivo di 40.000 – 60.000 € lordi annui, con la disponibilità a valutare anche proposte superiori per profili particolarmente senior o di valore eccezionale.
﻿Sono inoltre previsti un contributo di 1.000 € per il setup dell'home office, un piano AI premium a tua scelta e retreat aziendali in Italia.

Unisciti all'ecosistema con Blox Space!

Se vuoi rendere i modelli open-weight davvero affidabili e utili contro uno dei problemi più difficili della sicurezza, e farlo accanto a chi trova bug veri in sistemi veri, questa è l'opportunità che stavi aspettando: lavorare con una delle nostre partner companies significa entrare in un team innovativo e in forte crescita, al centro di un ecosistema dove circolano idee, competenze e progetti ad alta intensità. È un ambiente dove si costruisce, si testa, si discute e si migliora ogni giorno.

Role Title: Materials Scientist (Nanoparticle Sizing & Lot Release)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Materials Scientists (Nanoparticle Sizing & Lot Release) to contribute specialized expertise to a customer’s project focused on advanced nanomaterial evaluation. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity centers on thorough nanoparticle sizing, particle size distribution analysis, and lot release qualifications using Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) and Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM). The engagement emphasizes independent expert analysis — including manual image thresholding, calibration, and morphology assessments — without reliance on automated or AI-powered tools. Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential to document findings, interpret complex micrographs, and convey critical decisions to project stakeholders.

Scope of Work

  1. Manually analyze and interpret TEM and SEM micrographs for nanoparticle sizing and morphological assessment
  2. Determine and document particle size distributions (PSD) with rigorous attention to accuracy and reproducibility
  3. Establish and communicate lot-release acceptance criteria based on technical reference cases and quality control standards
  4. Prepare detailed reports summarizing findings, methodologies, and recommendations for material qualification
  5. Validate measurement techniques through manual calibration, thresholding, and cross-checking against reference data
  6. Participate in technical discussions, providing expert insights on nanomaterial characterization and quality control criteria
  7. Deliver clear, concise written and verbal communications to facilitate knowledge transfer across project teams

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Advanced knowledge of nanomaterial characterization, especially using TEM and SEM
  2. Demonstrated hands-on experience in nanoparticle sizing, particle size distribution analysis, and lot release evaluation
  3. Proficiency with manual image analysis, including thresholding, calibration, and interpretation of complex morphologies
  4. Strong understanding of quality control standards and reference material qualification protocols
  5. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for reporting and collaboration
  6. Ability to evaluate and validate technical reference cases without the use of AI-based tools
  7. Background in scientific consulting, materials science, or laboratory-based analytical roles is a plus

Coordinates all adjudication on Medicare D claims where needed and to perform all functions required to maintain, update, and bill customers’ accounts timely and accurately.

Job title: Mapping Admin Assistant

Type of employment: Full-time

Shift Schedule: Monday–Friday 8:00 AM–5:00 PM PST

High-level summary

Provide remote administrative support for creating, updating, and maintaining accurate property and equipment maps for Lighting, Plumbing, and HVAC services.

Complete assigned mapping work orders accurately and by required deadlines while keeping the Mapping Dashboard and related records up to date.

Provide cross-trained backup support for General Administration when assigned, following established procedures and the same accuracy and deadline expectations as regular mapping work.

About the Company:

A family-owned commercial service contractor serving Northern California, providing maintenance and service support across Lighting, Electrical, Plumbing, and Mechanical departments.

Company core values:

  • Excellence
  • Vision
  • Respect
  • Communication
  • Ownership

Objective of this role:

  • Create, update, and maintain accurate property and equipment maps for Lighting, Plumbing, and HVAC services.
  • Complete assigned mapping work orders by their required deadlines.
  • Keep the Mapping Dashboard, FieldOps records, and applicable trackers accurate and current.
  • Identify missing or conflicting information and seek clarification before making unsupported changes.
  • Provide General Administration backup support when assigned.

Responsibilities:

Mapping & Work Orders

  • Create, update, and correct site maps for Lighting, Plumbing, and HVAC using work orders, site records, photos, and provided instructions.
  • Update fixture and equipment locations, identification numbers, labels, and related map records.
  • Confirm map changes match supporting documentation.
  • Process assigned pole-labeling work orders and update corresponding map labels and records.
  • Prepare blank maps requested by internal teams and save or distribute them according to procedures.
  • Check requests for missing or conflicting information and seek clarification before making unsupported changes.
  • Review completed maps and work orders for accuracy.

Deadlines, Dashboard & Communication

  • Monitor and prioritize assigned work orders to ensure completion by required deadlines.
  • Communicate potential delays before deadlines are missed.
  • Update the Mapping Dashboard with accurate statuses, completed work, and pending items.
  • Flag missing information, workload conflicts, or at-risk deadlines to the Team Lead.
  • Record work performed and attach or retain required maps, notes, and supporting documentation in FieldOps and applicable trackers.
  • Send thank-you letters to customers to confirm map accuracy.
  • Follow up on outstanding responses and coordinate necessary corrections before maps are finalized and dispatched for onsite mapping.

General Administration Backup Coverage

  • Cross-train on General Administration tasks and complete them when assigned.
  • Enter or correct customer and property contact information.
  • Set up new sites using supplied site, customer, service, and contact information.
  • Process assigned administrative work orders and record completion notes.
  • Prepare or route pre-lien documentation following established processes and deadlines.
  • Coordinate requests for Certificates of Insurance (COIs), verify required information, and route or track documentation.
  • Update account and technician assignments and related tracking reports when directed.
  • Update administrative trackers and prepare requested status or reassignment reports.

Required skills and qualifications:

  • Administrative experience is required.
  • Strong attention to detail when working with maps, equipment labels, numbers, and work-order instructions.
  • Ability to manage multiple assigned work orders and prioritize tasks by deadline.
  • Ability to consistently complete assigned tasks on time.
  • Clear written English communication skills.
  • Reliable follow-through on assigned work and questions.
  • Ability to work independently after training.
  • Ability to follow established procedures.
  • Ability to identify unclear instructions and escalate matters requiring approval.
  • Reliable availability during business hours.
  • Willingness to cross-train for team coverage.

Preferred skills and qualifications:

  • Familiarity with administrative work orders and service-related documentation.
  • Comfort working with maps, property records, equipment information, and detailed instructions.
  • Familiarity with FieldOps, Google Maps, Google Sheets, Publisher, or Front.
  • Ability to quickly learn specific systems and procedures.
  • Previous experience supporting teams that manage multiple work orders or service-related tasks.

Additional Requirements:﻿

  • Tech Specs: Laptop: High-spec, e.g., 16GB RAM, 256GB SSD, i5 10th gen+ or Ryzen equivalent.
  • Dual monitors are required.
  • ﻿﻿Internet: Two separate, wired connections (e.g., PLDT + Converge). Mobile data is not a sufficient backup.

Descripción

INGENIERO/A DE DESARROLLO DE PRODUCTO – CAD | PROYECTOS DE INYECCIÓN (REMOTO)

Compañía especializada en diseño y fabricación de moldes para la industria manufacturera europea se encuentra en la búsqueda de un/a Ingeniero/a de Desarrollo de Producto – CAD para acompañar proyectos técnicos desde la etapa de análisis hasta la validación de soluciones, trabajando de forma cercana con clientes industriales y equipos internos.

Este rol está pensado para un perfil ingeniero/a junior–intermedio, con bases sólidas en diseño CAD y procesos de inyección, que quiera fortalecer su experiencia en desarrollo de producto, interacción técnica con clientes y mejora continua en entornos industriales internacionales.

Requisitos

FORMACIÓN ACADÉMICA

Profesional en Ingeniería Mecánica, Mecatrónica, Industrial o afines.
Formación adicional en Diseño de Producto, CAD o Gestión de Proyectos (deseable, no excluyente).
Conocimientos de Excel y Power BI son importantes para seguimiento de proyectos y análisis técnico.

EXPERIENCIA & CONOCIMIENTOS

Experiencia mínima de 1 a 3 años en diseño de producto, moldes o proyectos técnicos industriales.
Manejo de herramientas de diseño CAD 3D (SolidWorks u otro software similar).
Conocimiento básico–intermedio de procesos de inyección de plásticos y criterios de manufacturabilidad.
Experiencia o interés en análisis de factibilidad técnica y acompañamiento a clientes.
Nivel de inglés intermedio (lectura y comunicación técnica básica).
Deseable experiencia previa en entornos industriales o sector plástico (no excluyente).

RESPONSABILIDADES CLAVE

Apoyar el desarrollo técnico de productos y moldes según requerimientos del cliente.
Analizar la viabilidad técnica de nuevos proyectos desde el diseño y la manufactura.
Acompañar técnicamente a clientes durante las fases de diseño, ajustes y validación.
Asegurar el cumplimiento de especificaciones técnicas, tiempos y estándares de calidad.
Participar en pruebas técnicas, homologaciones y ajustes de diseño.
Identificar oportunidades de mejora en procesos de diseño y desarrollo de producto.

FUNCIONES PRINCIPALES

Elaborar diseños CAD de productos nuevos y modificaciones sobre diseños existentes.
Coordinar información técnica con áreas de ingeniería, producción y calidad.
Documentar especificaciones técnicas y avances de proyectos en sistemas internos.
Realizar seguimiento a pruebas de funcionamiento y ajustes requeridos.
Brindar soporte técnico básico a clientes industriales durante el desarrollo del proyecto.
Proponer soluciones técnicas frente a observaciones, cambios o no conformidades.

COMPETENCIAS BLANDAS

Atención al detalle y rigurosidad técnica.
Pensamiento analítico para evaluar alternativas de diseño y manufactura.
Comunicación clara para interactuar con equipos técnicos y clientes.
Organización y gestión del tiempo en entornos de múltiples proyectos.
Actitud de aprendizaje y mejora continua.

OPORTUNIDAD & BENEFICIOS

Participación en proyectos técnicos para clientes industriales europeos.
Exposición real a procesos de desarrollo de producto e inyección plástica.
Modalidad 100 % remota.

Contrato a término indefinido.

Entorno técnico con aprendizaje continuo y acompañamiento.
Compensación acorde al nivel del rol.
Beneficios adicionales: bonificaciones por cumplimiento, capacitaciones técnicas y programas de bienestar.

Si eres ingeniero/a, te interesa el diseño técnico aplicado, quieres fortalecer tu experiencia en desarrollo de producto y trabajar en proyectos industriales con clientes internacionales, esta oportunidad es para ti.
