About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially driven Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead the strategic growth, operational performance, and long-term value creation of a diversified Construction & Real Estate business.

The CEO will have overall responsibility for the organization's strategy, P&L, business development, construction operations, real estate development, investment decisions, people leadership, and stakeholder management.

The ideal candidate will be a proven senior executive with substantial experience in construction, property development, real estate investment, infrastructure, engineering, or related sectors, with a strong track record of scaling businesses, managing large project portfolios, and delivering sustainable profitability.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategy & Corporate Leadership

Develop and execute the company's short-, medium-, and long-term corporate strategy.

Lead business expansion across construction, property development, real estate investment, and related businesses.

Identify new markets, development opportunities, strategic partnerships, and investment opportunities.

Establish clear organizational objectives, KPIs, budgets, and performance targets.

Provide strategic recommendations and regular business updates to the Board.

2. P&L & Financial Management

Take full ownership of the company's P&L, cash flow, profitability, and financial performance.

Develop annual budgets, forecasts, capital plans, and investment strategies.

Improve margins, operational efficiency, working capital, and return on invested capital.

Oversee project economics, development feasibility, financing structures, and capital allocation.

Maintain strong relationships with banks, investors, institutional partners, and other financial stakeholders.

3. Construction & Project Delivery

Provide executive oversight of the company's construction portfolio and major development projects.

Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, to specification, and in compliance with applicable standards.

Establish strong project governance, cost controls, procurement processes, and risk-management frameworks.

Monitor contractor, consultant, supplier, and project-partner performance.

Ensure robust health, safety, quality, environmental, and regulatory standards across operations.

4. Real Estate Development & Investment

Lead the identification, evaluation, acquisition, development, and commercialization of real estate opportunities.

Oversee land acquisition, feasibility studies, master planning, development approvals, construction, sales/leasing, and asset disposition.

Evaluate development pipelines and investment proposals based on market demand, risk, and expected returns.

Build and maintain relationships with landowners, developers, investors, government authorities, brokers, and strategic partners.

Drive portfolio optimization and maximize the value of the company's real estate assets.

5. Business Development & Commercial Growth

Develop and execute strategies to increase revenue, market share, and profitability.

Build relationships with major corporate clients, government entities, institutional investors, developers, and strategic partners.

Lead negotiations for major contracts, joint ventures, development agreements, and strategic partnerships.

Identify opportunities for diversification and new revenue streams.

Strengthen the company's market reputation and competitive positioning.

6. Governance, Risk & Compliance

Ensure the organization operates in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, contractual obligations, and corporate governance standards.

Establish enterprise-wide risk-management practices covering financial, operational, legal, construction, market, and investment risks.

Maintain strong governance across subsidiaries, projects, joint ventures, and investments.

Ensure transparency, accountability, and effective internal controls.

7. Leadership & Organizational Development

Build, lead, and retain a high-performing executive leadership team.

Develop organizational structures and talent strategies aligned with business growth.

Establish a culture focused on accountability, execution, innovation, safety, and commercial performance.

Coach and develop senior leaders and ensure effective succession planning.

Promote collaboration across construction, development, finance, commercial, legal, sales, and operations functions.

8. Stakeholder & Government Relations

Act as the principal representative of the company with the Board, investors, regulators, government authorities, financial institutions, clients, partners, and community stakeholders.

Develop strong relationships with government and regulatory bodies relevant to construction and real estate development.

Represent the organization at industry events, investment forums, and strategic business engagements.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The CEO will be accountable for:

Revenue and EBITDA/PAT growth

Overall P&L performance

Project delivery against budget and timelines

Gross margins and project profitability

Real estate portfolio growth and asset value creation

Return on invested capital

New business and development pipeline

Cash flow and working-capital performance

Customer and stakeholder satisfaction

Safety and quality performance

Employee engagement and leadership development

Strategic partnerships and market expansion

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive leadership experience, with significant senior management exposure in construction, real estate, property development, infrastructure, engineering, or a closely related sector.

Previous experience as CEO, Managing Director, Deputy CEO, COO, Executive Director, Business Unit President, or equivalent senior leadership position.

Proven experience managing a large-scale P&L and multidisciplinary organization.

Demonstrated success in construction project delivery and/or real estate development.

Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budgeting, investment analysis, cash-flow management, and capital allocation.

Proven track record of business growth, market expansion, and value creation.

Experience managing major contractors, developers, consultants, investors, financial institutions, and government stakeholders.

Strong understanding of construction contracts, development economics, procurement, project risk, and real estate markets.

Preferred Experience

Experience managing a diversified construction and real estate group or holding company.

Exposure to large-scale residential, commercial, industrial, mixed-use, hospitality, infrastructure, or urban-development projects.

Experience with joint ventures, PPPs, institutional investors, private equity, or international development partners.

Experience leading organizational transformation, restructuring, or rapid business expansion.

International or multi-country experience is highly desirable.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Real Estate, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline.

Master's degree/MBA is preferred.

Professional qualifications in engineering, project management, finance, real estate, or related fields will be advantageous.

Core Competencies

Strategic Leadership

Commercial & Financial Acumen

P&L Management

Real Estate Development

Construction & Project Management

Investment & Capital Allocation

Business Development

Negotiation & Contract Management

Risk Management

Corporate Governance

Stakeholder Management

Government Relations

Organizational Transformation

Executive Team Leadership

Decision-Making & Problem Solving

Leadership Characteristics

The successful CEO will be:

Commercially aggressive but financially disciplined

Strategic yet highly execution-oriented

Comfortable managing complex and high-value projects

A strong negotiator and relationship builder

Data-driven and financially sophisticated

Capable of operating effectively with Boards, investors, governments, and major clients

Comfortable making high-stakes decisions in complex and rapidly changing environments

A builder of strong leadership teams and organizational culture

Role Title: Senior Protection Engineer (Medium Voltage / Utility Distribution)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Senior Protection Engineer (Medium Voltage / Utility Distribution) experts to contribute their technical expertise to a customer's project in the utility distribution sector. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

  1. Assess and validate protection system reference cases, including relay settings, coordination curves, and protection logs for medium voltage utility distribution networks.
  2. Review and provide feedback on technical documentation related to protective relaying and device coordination practices.
  3. Analyze power system studies such as fault current analysis and equipment protection reviews, utilizing recognized industry methodologies.
  4. Evaluate and critique the application of protective relays (SEL, GE, or equivalent microprocessor-based relays) in medium voltage environments.
  5. Develop detailed, well-structured written responses and rationales explaining your analysis and recommendations.
  6. Collaborate with project managers and technical leads via clear, professional written and verbal communication.
  7. Support the creation of realistic, diverse scenarios that reflect U.S. distribution-utility or industrial standards for training and validation purposes.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Minimum 8 years of hands-on experience in medium-voltage (2.4kV–38kV) protection engineering within U.S. utility distribution or industrial settings.
  2. Strong background in protective relaying, relay settings, power system analysis, and device coordination.
  3. Proficiency with SEL, GE, or standard microprocessor relays and associated software.
  4. Advanced skill in power system modeling tools such as ETAP, ASPEN, or CAPE.
  5. Ability to synthesize and communicate complex technical concepts clearly in both written and verbal formats.
  6. Demonstrated attention to detail and analytical rigor when reviewing technical materials and data sets.
  7. Previous experience validating or creating technical documentation, protection settings, or relay coordination studies is highly regarded.

Department: Product & Engineering

Reports to: Head of Engineering

Location: Remote based out of Lahore, Pakistan

About Wise Pelican

Wise Pelican is hiring and growing its Development team with another Senior Software Engineer. We want a builder who loves thinking about product and has the catch phrase, “I can fix that.”

You’ll take ideas, especially around AI and our real estate marketing product, and turn them into things that make a tangible impact on our clients’ real world work. That means shipping code, talking to customers, untangling messy workflows, and owning the last 10% that makes or breaks our product.

We’re a bootstrapped company, so everything we build matters. Revenue, client retention, internal ease-of-use; you help move the needle on all of it.

This is a contract, remote position located based out of Lahore, Pakistan.

What Will You Do?

  • Partner with the Head of Engineering and cross-functional leaders to identify product and AI opportunities tied to revenue, customer success, efficiency, or long-term company value.
  • Work directly with customers and internal teams to understand their workflows, uncover the actual problem, and translate ambiguous business needs into a clear technical plan.
  • Build full-stack solutions using Python, TypeScript, and React, including product features, internal tools, integrations, data workflows, and AI-supported applications.
  • Own projects from discovery and prototyping through testing, production deployment, adoption, and ongoing improvement.
  • Define what success should look like before development begins and measure whether the finished solution creates the intended business or customer outcome.
  • Make practical decisions about scope, speed, maintainability, security, and technical quality so projects move forward without creating avoidable messes behind them.
  • Turn successful customer-specific or internal solutions into reusable components, documented playbooks, and scalable product capabilities.
  • Bring lessons from customers and real-world deployments back to the broader product roadmap.
  • Keep stakeholders informed, surface risks early, and create enough structure to prevent important work from getting lost between departments.

What Big Things Will You Own?

At First

  • Learn Wise Pelican’s product, technical architecture, business model, customer workflows, and current AI initiatives.
  • Partner with the Head of Engineering to define the initial purpose, priorities, success measures, and working model for our Senior Software Development function.
  • Review our current pipeline of product and AI ideas to identify the projects with the clearest path to revenue, user success, or meaningful operational leverage.
  • Take an existing prototype, stalled initiative, or high-priority business problem through the final stretch and into reliable production use.
  • Establish lightweight standards for project discovery, technical scoping, deployment, documentation, feedback, and outcome measurement.

Once You Get Your Footing

  • Own a portfolio of internal and customer-facing initiatives from business problem through measurable result.
  • Build reusable tools, integrations, and implementation patterns so each successful project makes the next one faster and more valuable.
  • Help determine when a customer need should remain a tailored solution and when it should become part of Wise Pelican’s core product.
  • Help shape and eventually scale the Forward Deployed Engineering function, including its goals, processes, responsibilities, and future hiring needs.

Who Are You?

  • You have a strong software engineering foundation and evidence that you have shipped real, working software, beyond coursework, tutorials, or prototypes that have never met a paying user.
  • You are comfortable building production applications with Python, TypeScript, and React.
  • You understand full-stack development fundamentals, including APIs, databases, testing, debugging, deployment, authentication, and cloud-based systems.
  • You can independently work through technical problems and know when to ask for context, support, or a second opinion.
  • You can speak with customers, executives, developers, and nontechnical stakeholders without requiring everyone else to learn your language first.
  • You communicate progress, tradeoffs, risks, and changing expectations before they become surprises.
  • You enjoy understanding how a business works and can connect technical decisions to revenue, adoption, efficiency, risk, and customer outcomes.
  • You are comfortable beginning with an unclear problem, asking direct questions, organizing the moving pieces, and creating a reasonable path forward.
  • You use numerous AI development tools thoughtfully.
  • You want to build and deliver, not recommend what someone else should build.

Where Can You Easily Impress Us?

  • You have built or deployed production systems involving LLMs, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluations, guardrails, or human-in-the-loop workflows.
  • You have worked directly with customers through implementation, solutions engineering, technical consulting, product development, or a similar role.
  • You have experience inside an early-stage or bootstrapped company where you had to operate without layers of process, specialized teams, or unlimited resources.
  • You have worked with marketing automation, CRMs, HubSpot, real estate technology, workflow automation, or data-heavy SaaS products.
  • You can show us a project where you identified the problem, built the solution, launched it, and learned whether it actually worked.

What’s In It for You?

  • Compensation: This role is currently benchmarked between $55,000 and $65,000 per year. Offered compensation will be based on relevant technical depth, demonstrated ability to ship production software, and readiness to independently own customer-facing deployments.
Salary: $55,000 – $65,000 / year

Canacre is seeking an Environmental Project Manager based Remotely out of the Philadelphia Area.

The Environmental Project Manager is responsible for managing environmental projects from planning and permitting through execution and completion. This role combines project management expertise with a strong working knowledge of environmental regulations, permitting processes, and regulatory agency coordination at the federal, state, and local levels.

The successful candidate will have experience managing projects involving wetland delineations and permitting, threatened and endangered species, and cultural and historic resources. They will understand how these resource areas intersect with environmental review, regulatory consultations, and permitting requirements, and will be able to coordinate the technical specialists, clients, subcontractors, and agencies necessary to advance projects efficiently and compliantly.

The Environmental Project Manager is accountable for project scope, schedule, budget, quality assurance, risk management, forecasting, and client satisfaction. This individual will serve as a primary point of contact for clients, lead internal project teams, anticipate regulatory and project risks, and ensure deliverables meet applicable requirements and client expectations.

What You'll Do

  • Project and Client Management

    • Manage environmental projects from initiation through completion, ensuring deliverables meet established scope, schedule, budget, quality, and client expectations.
    • Coordinate internal resources, establish priorities and performance expectations, track milestones, and ensure timely completion of project deliverables.
    • Serve as a primary point of contact for clients, providing regular project updates, progress reports, recommendations, and solutions.
    • Lead recurring client and internal project meetings to communicate progress, address concerns, document decisions, and track action items.
    • Monitor project schedules, budgets, forecasts, expenses, and timesheets; identify variances and implement corrective actions as needed.
    • Identify project risks, manage scope changes, develop contingency plans, and escalate issues to senior management when appropriate.
    • Identify and document change orders, prepare supporting documentation, and coordinate negotiations with clients.
    • Review project deliverables for technical accuracy, completeness, quality, and compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements.
    • Maintain project documentation and follow Canacre’s established project management procedures and best practices.
    • Coordinate with Business Development to identify opportunities to expand services with existing and prospective clients.
    • Ensure applicable safety, training, and project-specific requirements are met.

    Environmental Permitting and Regulatory Compliance

    • Manage environmental permitting and compliance activities involving wetlands, waters of the United States, threatened and endangered species, cultural and historic resources, and other applicable environmental resource areas.
    • Coordinate wetland delineations and related field assessments, technical documentation, jurisdictional determinations, and permitting requirements.
    • Manage or coordinate applications and supporting documentation for permits under Section 404 of the Clean Water Act, including Nationwide Permits and Individual Permits issued by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE).
    • Coordinate with applicable USACE Districts, federal and state resource agencies, and local authorities to advance permitting, resolve regulatory issues, and secure necessary approvals.
    • Coordinate threatened and endangered species assessments and consultations with the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (USFWS) and other applicable agencies.
    • Oversee coordination with archaeological and cultural resources subcontractors and specialists to support compliance with Section 106 of the National Historic Preservation Act and other applicable cultural resource requirements.
    • Manage environmental review and permitting activities under the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA), including projects involving the Bureau of Land Management (BLM), as applicable.
    • Develop and implement technically sound permitting strategies that account for project design, environmental constraints, agency requirements, and regulatory schedules.
    • Advise clients and internal teams on applicable federal, state, and local environmental regulations, permitting pathways, consultation requirements, and permit conditions.
    • Integrate findings and requirements from wetlands, biological resources, cultural resources, and other technical studies into project planning, environmental documentation, and permitting strategies.
    • Coordinate technical specialists, subcontractors, clients, and regulatory agencies to resolve environmental issues and keep projects moving toward approval.
    • Track permit conditions, regulatory commitments, agency correspondence, and approval milestones to support compliance throughout the project lifecycle.
    • Support the development of stakeholder communications and project messaging, including communications involving landowners and local communities.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Natural Resources, or a related field. A master’s degree is an asset.
  • 7-15 years experience in wetlands, threatened and endangered species, understands cultural resources and how they all relate to local, state and federal environmental permitting.
  • Experience managing wetland delineations
  • Experience with Section 404 of the Clean Water Act
  • Experience with Section 106 of the National Historic Preservation Act
  • Experience applying for Nationwide Permits or Individual Permits with the US Army Corps of Engineers (USACE)
  • Experience coordinating threatened and endangered species consultations with US Fish and Wildlife Service (USFWS)
  • Experience with NEPA relating to Bureau of Land Management (BLM)
  • Demonstrated experience managing environmental permitting projects and coordinating technical specialists and subcontractors.

What You'll Get

Compensation Range: $75,000–$130,000 (Based on Education and Experience) + Benefits

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage - Multiple Medical, dental & vision plans with 100% preventive care
  • 24/7 telehealth (Teladoc)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Education Reimbursement and Professional Development

Decision Inc. is currently looking for a Contract Business Systems Analyst to join our Automated Digital Applications team. The Business Systems Analyst will engage with client stakeholders to understand requirements and business problems and how these need to be solved through the implementation of IT solutions.

Who Are We?

Decision Inc. is a global digital partner that enables businesses to reinvent themselves to realise their full potential.

We deliver agility, resilience, and intelligence to any enterprise, enabling them to adapt quickly and thrive through innovation and opportunity. Our teams have engaged with more than 400 clients globally over the past 15 years, providing them with the expertise to build, operate, and optimise their digital businesses.

We achieve this by leveraging the world's best technology to drive our client's business ambitions forward into tomorrow's reality. These technologies include but are not limited to: Microsoft, SAP, Qlik, Snowflake, Alteryx, Automation Anywhere, and Workday Adaptive Insights.

Our success is ultimately driven by our entrepreneurial culture, industry exposure, and the passion of our people. We have three key cross-functional teams – Functional and Specialist Consulting, Development, and Engineering teams. Based in four global offices, our exceptional consultants focus on delivering value to clients by keeping them at the centre of our service delivery. To find out more about our exciting fast-paced culture visit: Careers at Decision Inc.

What Will You Do?

Key Responsibility:

Consultation

  • Quickly understand the client environment and industry, their business challenges, and issues
  • Elicit underlying problems and make recommendations and suggestions from a business and systems perspective to the client
  • Become a subject matter expert in the industries and business functions of the clients we engage in
  • Work together with UX/UI specialists to research and understand client business and industries to provide developers with insights and information to enable the creation of solutions and systems that create value for the customer
  • Manage client expectations effectively on assigned projects

Scoping

  • Initiate dialog with business areas to develop an understanding of their business needs and gaps
  • Perform requirements gathering & analysis through client interviews and workshops
  • Conduct and attend JAD sessions to solve business requirements
  • Prioritize independently, multiple requests and system requirements to meet the organisational goals
  • Identify client organisation's strengths and weaknesses and suggests areas of improvement
  • Documenting business and system requirements including business process, workflow and user interface
  • Develop project artifacts such as user stories, functional specifications and system design specifications for client solution requirement
  • Translate business requirements into technical requirements and communicate needed changes to development teams

Development

  • Ensure alignment between customer requirements and developer team
  • Ensure issues are identified, tracked, reported on and resolved in a timely manner with support of PMO team
  • Communicate needed changes to development team
  • Assist in the facilitation of team and client meetings

Implementation

  • Draw up test cases and perform solution quality assurance
  • Perform testing to validate accuracy of delivered solutions
  • Ensure issues are identified and resolved in a timely manner
  • Continually seek opportunities to increase customer satisfaction and deepen client relationships

Administration

  • Implement and coordinate documentation and project files for all projects
  • Create user guides
  • Prepare and setup client staff business training content

Technical

  • The successful candidate will be required to become up-skilled in the Microsoft technologies stack in order to better understand how client challenges can be solved
  • The candidate will learn how to use low/no code platforms to develop client solutions to solve business requirements and challenges and to automate and digitize their business processes

Who Do You Need to Be?

Essential

  • 4-5 years Business Analysis experience
  • Process Design & Optimisation experience
  • Exposure to all SDLC and/or Agile/Waterfall project methodologies
  • Well-developed communications and presentation skills with the ability to work in a team environment bringing various skills together
  • The ability to work independently with both technical and business users at various levels
  • Extensive knowledge of business systems
  • Extensive quality assurance experience and best practices in this space
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail and quality
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking
  • Excellent grammatical, writing and editorial skills are required
  • Ability to network and cultivate productive working relationships
  • Time management, prioritization and organization with the ability to prioritize activities and lead multiple tasks at once
  • Working with all levels within an organization including senior executives, managers, front lines, corporate and technical staff

Advantageous

  • IT Degree (Bcom/BSc/Btech) or similar
  • Business Analysis courses or certifications
  • Project Management or Administration experience
  • Experience with Microsoft tools such as Visio
  • Experience in Low/no code development and automation platforms such as Nintex, Power Apps, Automation Anywhere etc.

Position Overview

The Chief Client Officer is responsible for leading the organization's client strategy, relationship management, and client success functions across all segments. The role focuses on driving long-term client value, satisfaction, retention, and growth by ensuring exceptional service delivery and deep, trusted client relationships. The CCO acts as the executive voice of the client within the organization.

Key Responsibilities

Client Strategy & Relationship Management

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive client strategy aligned with business goals.
  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with key clients and strategic accounts.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for high-value client issues and engagements.

Client Growth & Retention

  • Drive client retention, loyalty, and expansion across portfolios.
  • Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing client base.
  • Develop strategies to increase client lifetime value (CLV).

Client Experience & Success

  • Ensure consistent delivery of high-quality client experience across all touchpoints.
  • Oversee client onboarding, engagement, and success management processes.
  • Implement frameworks to measure and improve client satisfaction (NPS, CSAT).

Account Management & Delivery Oversight

  • Oversee key account management teams and client delivery functions.
  • Ensure client expectations are met through effective service delivery.
  • Coordinate resolution of complex client issues with internal teams.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with sales, operations, product, marketing, and support teams.
  • Ensure client feedback is integrated into product development and service improvements.
  • Align internal teams around client needs and priorities.

Client Insights & Analytics

  • Analyze client behavior, feedback, and performance data.
  • Identify trends and opportunities to improve client engagement and satisfaction.
  • Provide actionable insights to executive leadership.

Business Development Support

  • Support sales teams in acquiring high-value clients and strategic accounts.
  • Participate in client pitches, presentations, and negotiations.
  • Strengthen executive-level client relationships during pre- and post-sales cycles.

Governance & Reporting

  • Establish KPIs for client success, retention, and growth.
  • Provide regular reports and updates to CEO and executive leadership.
  • Ensure compliance with service level agreements (SLAs) and contractual obligations.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and mentor client success, account management, and service teams.
  • Build a client-centric culture across the organization.
  • Drive continuous training and professional development initiatives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Marketing, or related field; MBA preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of experience in client management, account management, customer success, or senior leadership roles.
  • Proven track record of managing enterprise or high-value client relationships.
  • Strong experience in service delivery, relationship management, or client success leadership.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Exceptional relationship-building and communication skills.
  • Strong strategic and commercial thinking.
  • Customer-centric leadership mindset.
  • Analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Cross-functional collaboration and influence skills.
  • Executive presence and stakeholder management.

Performance Metrics

  • Client retention and churn rate.
  • Client satisfaction (CSAT) and Net Promoter Score (NPS).
  • Revenue growth from existing clients.
  • Success of key account management initiatives.
  • SLA adherence and service quality performance.

  • Yes/No prerequisite screening questions
  • MCQ knockout questions

  • Industry-specific versions (banking, SaaS, consulting, fintech)

Mergers, Acquisitions & Partnerships

Cross-Functional Leadership

Innovation & Future Planning

Performance Metrics

  • M&A and partnership value creation.
  • Alignment and execution efficiency across business units.

Position:Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the financial strategy, financial performance, capital management, investment finance, treasury, reporting, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investment organization.

The CFO will serve as a key member of the executive leadership team and strategic advisor to the CEO/President and Board, providing leadership across financial planning, insurance accounting, capital and solvency management, investment portfolio performance, asset-liability management, treasury, risk, regulatory reporting, and corporate development.

The successful candidate will combine deep financial expertise with strong commercial and investment acumen and will be capable of operating in a highly regulated financial-services environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Strategy & Executive Leadership

Develop and execute the organization's overall financial strategy.

Advise the CEO, President, and Board on financial performance, capital allocation, investment strategy, and enterprise value creation.

Translate corporate strategy into financial plans, budgets, forecasts, and measurable objectives.

Lead financial decision-making across insurance, investment, and corporate operations.

Establish strong financial governance and accountability across the organization.

2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Performance

Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning.

Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support strategic decisions.

Monitor revenue, profitability, expenses, capital efficiency, and operating performance.

Establish financial KPIs and executive dashboards.

Identify opportunities to improve profitability, efficiency, and shareholder returns.

3. Insurance Finance & Performance

Oversee financial management of insurance operations, including premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, and underwriting performance.

Monitor key insurance financial metrics including loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting profitability.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk teams to assess financial performance and emerging exposures.

Ensure appropriate financial treatment and reporting of insurance liabilities and reserves.

Support pricing, product profitability, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions from a financial perspective.

4. Investment Finance & Portfolio Management

Provide financial oversight of the organization's investment portfolio and investment activities.

Partner with the CIO/Chief Investment Officer and Investment Committee on portfolio strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, realized/unrealized gains, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted returns.

Evaluate investment opportunities and strategic asset-allocation decisions.

Ensure investment activities are aligned with the organization's liabilities, liquidity requirements, risk appetite, and regulatory requirements.

5. Capital, Solvency & Balance Sheet Management

Lead capital planning and balance-sheet optimization.

Monitor solvency, capital adequacy, liquidity, leverage, and financial resilience.

Develop strategies to optimize the organization's capital structure and return on capital.

Assess the financial impact of major business, investment, and insurance decisions on capital requirements.

Work closely with Risk and Actuarial functions on capital and solvency assessments.

6. Asset-Liability Management (ALM)

Provide executive financial oversight of asset-liability management.

Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.

Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.

Support development of ALM strategies and balance-sheet optimization initiatives.

Ensure appropriate financial stress testing and scenario analysis.

7. Treasury & Liquidity

Oversee treasury, cash management, liquidity planning, and banking relationships.

Maintain adequate liquidity to meet claims, operating obligations, investment commitments, and strategic requirements.

Optimize cash deployment and short-term investment strategies.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

Establish robust treasury policies and controls.

8. Regulatory & Financial Reporting

Ensure accurate, timely, and transparent financial reporting to the Board, shareholders, regulators, and other stakeholders.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and consolidated financial statements.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Lead relationships with external auditors, regulators, actuarial advisers, tax advisers, and other professional stakeholders.

Maintain strong financial controls and governance frameworks.

9. Risk Management & Financial Controls

Establish effective financial risk-management frameworks.

Monitor exposure to market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, operational, interest-rate, and foreign-exchange risks.

Strengthen internal controls, financial policies, and governance processes.

Work closely with the CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and other executives to manage enterprise-wide financial risks.

Ensure appropriate stress testing and contingency planning.

10. Reinsurance & Capital Optimization

Provide financial oversight of reinsurance strategy and economics.

Evaluate the financial and capital implications of reinsurance arrangements.

Monitor reinsurance recoverables, counterparty exposure, and profitability.

Support optimization of risk transfer, capital efficiency, and balance-sheet resilience.

11. Corporate Development & Strategic Investments

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, strategic investments, joint ventures, and business expansion opportunities.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and investment cases.

Assess potential M&A opportunities and their impact on capital, solvency, earnings, and shareholder value.

Support negotiations with investors, financial institutions, and strategic partners.

12. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Develop strong relationships with shareholders, institutional investors, banks, rating agencies, regulators, and other financial stakeholders.

Communicate financial performance, capital strategy, investment results, and business outlook to key stakeholders.

Support investor presentations, Board materials, and strategic financial communications.

13. Finance Transformation & Technology

Modernize finance systems, reporting infrastructure, ERP platforms, and financial analytics.

Improve automation, data quality, forecasting, and management reporting.

Establish real-time visibility into financial, insurance, investment, and risk performance.

Drive continuous improvement within the finance function.

14. Leadership & Talent Development

Lead Finance, FP&A, Treasury, Accounting, Financial Reporting, Tax, and related functions.

Build a high-performing and commercially focused finance organization.

Develop finance leadership talent and succession plans.

Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, financial discipline, and business partnership.

Key Performance Indicators

The CFO will be accountable for:

Revenue and earnings growth

Operating and net profitability

Return on equity (ROE)

Return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Investment income and risk-adjusted returns

Combined ratio / underwriting profitability

Expense efficiency

Liquidity and cash-flow management

Balance-sheet optimization

Budget and forecast accuracy

Regulatory and financial reporting quality

Cost of capital

Financial risk management

Shareholder value creation

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive finance experience, including significant executive leadership.

Previous experience as CFO, Group CFO, Finance Director, VP Finance, Deputy CFO, or equivalent.

Significant experience within insurance, asset management, investment management, banking, pensions, financial services, or a related regulated financial institution.

Strong understanding of insurance financial statements, investment portfolios, capital management, and regulatory requirements.

Proven experience managing complex balance sheets, liquidity, capital, and financial performance.

Strong experience working with Boards, regulators, auditors, investors, rating agencies, and senior executives.

Demonstrated experience in financial strategy, investment analysis, and capital allocation.

Preferred Experience

Experience as Group CFO within a diversified insurance or financial-services group.

Experience across both insurance and investment/asset-management businesses.

Experience with life insurance, general insurance, health insurance, pensions, or reinsurance.

Exposure to institutional investment portfolios and alternative investments.

Experience with M&A, strategic investments, capital raising, restructuring, or corporate transformation.

Experience operating across multiple jurisdictions or regulated markets.

Experience interacting with insurance regulators and rating agencies.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

MBA or Master's degree in Finance/Business is an advantage.

Relevant insurance, actuarial, investment, or risk-management qualifications are advantageous.

Core Competencies

Insurance Finance

Corporate Finance

Investment Finance

Capital & Solvency Management

Asset-Liability Management

Treasury & Liquidity

Financial Planning & Analysis

Investment Analysis

Financial Modeling

Risk Management

Regulatory Reporting

Insurance Accounting

M&A & Corporate Development

Capital Allocation

Investor Relations

Corporate Governance

Financial Transformation

Leadership Characteristics

The successful CFO will be:

Strategic, commercially minded, and financially rigorous

Highly analytical and investment-oriented

Experienced in highly regulated environments

Strong in capital and balance-sheet management

Comfortable engaging with Boards, regulators, investors, and rating agencies

Able to balance growth, profitability, liquidity, capital, and risk

An effective strategic partner to the CEO, CIO, CRO, and Chief Actuary

Strong in complex financial decision-making

A transformational finance leader capable of building high-performing teams

Compensation

A competitive executive compensation package comprising base salary, performance-based incentives, executive benefits, and other benefits commensurate with experience and market benchmarks.

About this Role

Canacre’s core services focus on leadership in Environment and Land services throughout the project lifecycle. At Canacre, we emphasize continuous development and growth. Our commitment to investing in industry knowledge and the expertise of our teams sets us apart. Our goals are to provide technical leadership for greater regulatory understanding and certainty and to build collaborative relationships with stakeholders, mitigating tomorrow’s environment, land and right-of-way risks today.

Canacre’s core services focus on leadership in Environment and Land services throughout the project lifecycle. At Canacre, we emphasize continuous development and growth. Our commitment to investing in industry knowledge and the expertise of our teams sets us apart. Our goals are to provide technical leadership for greater regulatory understanding and certainty and to build collaborative relationships with stakeholders, mitigating tomorrow’s environment, land and right-of-way risks today.

At Canacre, we act with honesty and integrity within a culture where trust, collaboration, and teamwork flourish. We commit to diversity, inclusivity and the celebration of successes. Our vision is to foster an environment that promotes inspired and empowered team members who make an impact.

The Environmental Project Manager is responsible for managing environmental projects from planning and permitting through execution and completion. This role combines project management expertise with a strong working knowledge of environmental regulations, permitting processes, and regulatory agency coordination at the federal, state, and local levels. The successful candidate will have experience managing projects involving wetland delineations and permitting, threatened and endangered species, and cultural and historic resources. They will understand how these resource areas intersect with environmental review, regulatory consultations, and permitting requirements, and will be able to coordinate the technical specialists, clients, subcontractors, and agencies necessary to advance projects efficiently and compliantly. The Environmental Project Manager is accountable for project scope, schedule, budget, quality assurance, risk management, forecasting, and client satisfaction. This individual will serve as a primary point of contact for clients, lead internal project teams, anticipate regulatory and project risks, and ensure deliverables meet applicable requirements and client expectations.

What You'll Do

  • Project and Client Management

    • Manage environmental projects from initiation through completion, ensuring deliverables meet established scope, schedule, budget, quality, and client expectations.
    • Coordinate internal resources, establish priorities and performance expectations, track milestones, and ensure timely completion of project deliverables.
    • Serve as a primary point of contact for clients, providing regular project updates, progress reports, recommendations, and solutions.
    • Lead recurring client and internal project meetings to communicate progress, address concerns, document decisions, and track action items.
    • Monitor project schedules, budgets, forecasts, expenses, and timesheets; identify variances and implement corrective actions as needed.
    • Identify project risks, manage scope changes, develop contingency plans, and escalate issues to senior management when appropriate.
    • Identify and document change orders, prepare supporting documentation, and coordinate negotiations with clients.
    • Review project deliverables for technical accuracy, completeness, quality, and compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements.
    • Maintain project documentation and follow Canacre’s established project management procedures and best practices.
    • Coordinate with Business Development to identify opportunities to expand services with existing and prospective clients.
    • Ensure applicable safety, training, and project-specific requirements are met.

    Environmental Permitting and Regulatory Compliance

    • Manage environmental permitting and compliance activities involving wetlands, waters of the United States, threatened and endangered species, cultural and historic resources, and other applicable environmental resource areas.
    • Coordinate wetland delineations and related field assessments, technical documentation, jurisdictional determinations, and permitting requirements.
    • Manage or coordinate applications and supporting documentation for permits under Section 404 of the Clean Water Act, including Nationwide Permits and Individual Permits issued by the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE).
    • Coordinate with applicable USACE Districts, federal and state resource agencies, and local authorities to advance permitting, resolve regulatory issues, and secure necessary approvals.
    • Coordinate threatened and endangered species assessments and consultations with the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (USFWS) and other applicable agencies.
    • Oversee coordination with archaeological and cultural resources subcontractors and specialists to support compliance with Section 106 of the National Historic Preservation Act and other applicable cultural resource requirements.
    • Manage environmental review and permitting activities under the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA), including projects involving the Bureau of Land Management (BLM), as applicable.
    • Develop and implement technically sound permitting strategies that account for project design, environmental constraints, agency requirements, and regulatory schedules.
    • Advise clients and internal teams on applicable federal, state, and local environmental regulations, permitting pathways, consultation requirements, and permit conditions.
    • Integrate findings and requirements from wetlands, biological resources, cultural resources, and other technical studies into project planning, environmental documentation, and permitting strategies.
    • Coordinate technical specialists, subcontractors, clients, and regulatory agencies to resolve environmental issues and keep projects moving toward approval.
    • Track permit conditions, regulatory commitments, agency correspondence, and approval milestones to support compliance throughout the project lifecycle.
    • Support the development of stakeholder communications and project messaging, including communications involving landowners and local communities.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Biology, Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Natural Resources, or a related field. A master’s degree is an asset.
  • 10- 15 years experience in wetlands, threatened and endangered species, understands cultural resources and how they all relate to local, state and federal environmental permitting.
  • Experience managing wetland delineations
  • Experience with Section 404 of the Clean Water Act
  • Experience with Section 106 of the National Historic Preservation Act
  • Experience applying for Nationwide Permits or Individual Permits with the US Army Corps of Engineers (USACE)
  • Experience coordinating threatened and endangered species consultations with US Fish and Wildlife Service (USFWS)
  • Experience with NEPA relating to Bureau of Land Management (BLM)
  • Demonstrated experience managing environmental permitting projects and coordinating technical specialists and subcontractors.

What You'll Get

Compensation Range: $75,000–$130,000 (Based on Education and Experience) + Benefits

  • Competitive Compensation
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage - Multiple Medical, dental & vision plans with 100% preventive care
  • 24/7 telehealth (Teladoc)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Education Reimbursement and Professional Development

Equal Opportunity Employer

We prohibit all types of discrimination and are committed to providing access and equal opportunity for individuals with disabilities. The Chief Product Officer (CPO) leads the end-to-end product strategy, design, and lifecycle management of the organization's insurance portfolio. Define and execute the enterprise-wide insurance product strategy

Identify market opportunities, customer needs, and competitive positioning

Drive innovation across traditional and digital insurance offerings

2. Product Development & Lifecycle Management

Oversee design, development, launch, and optimization of insurance products

Ensure strong collaboration with underwriting, actuarial, distribution, and technology teams

Manage the full product lifecycle (concept launch growth retirement)

3. Pricing & Profitability

Partner with actuarial teams on pricing models and assumptions

Ensure product profitability, loss ratio targets, and portfolio performance

Optimize product mix and segmentation strategies

Ensure all products comply with regulatory requirements and approvals

Align with frameworks such as IFRS 17 and local insurance regulations

Work closely with legal, compliance, and regulatory bodies

Leverage data analytics to understand customer behavior and preferences

Drive customer-centric product design and digital experience enhancements

Monitor market trends and competitor offerings

6. Distribution & Go-to-Market

Collaborate with sales and distribution channels (agency, bancassurance, digital)

Define go-to-market strategies and product positioning

Support channel enablement and product training

7. Digital & Innovation

Lead digital product transformation (embedded insurance, insurtech partnerships)

Integrate AI, analytics, and automation into product design and delivery

Foster a culture of innovation and agile product development

Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Actuarial Science, or related field (MBA preferred)

15–20+ years of experience in insurance product management or underwriting

Strong understanding of life, health, and/or P&C insurance products

Proven track record in product innovation, profitability, and portfolio management

Experience working with actuarial, risk, and regulatory frameworks

Key Competencies

Strategic thinking and product vision

Strong commercial and financial acumen

Customer-centric mindset

Leadership and cross-functional collaboration

Innovation and digital transformation capability

raw.title: Manager, Marketplaces
raw.excerpt: Position Summary: Culligan Retail North America (CRNA) sells consumer water-filtration products, including the ZeroWater brand, through retail and e-commerce channels across the US and Canada.
raw.description:
Position Summary:

Culligan Retail North America (CRNA) sells consumer water-filtration products, including the ZeroWater brand, through retail and e-commerce channels across the US and Canada. Online retail is where a growing share of our consumers shop, from Walmart.com and Target.com to the wider set of dot-com accounts and seller-model marketplaces. We are creating this role to put dedicated ownership behind that business and grow it.

As Manager, Marketplaces, you will own our marketplace business end to end: the accounts we sell today and the digital shelf behind them. The role is hands-on, with direct influence on growth and profitability and close partnership across Marketing, Supply Chain and Finance.

Responsibilities:

Marketplace Account Ownership:

  • Owning the Walmart.com and Target.com businesses end to end, including assortment, item setup, pricing, promotions and in-stock performance.
  • Managing the remaining online retail dot-com accounts and seller-model (3P) marketplaces, including fulfillment model, fees and account health.
  • Building the day-to-day relationships with merchant, site and operations contacts at each account.
  • Running a promotional and event calendar by account, from seasonal moments to retailer-led events.

Digital Shelf:

  • Owning content, imagery, ratings and reviews, and search performance across marketplaces, working with Marketing on brand assets and messaging.
  • Monitoring pricing and competitive activity across accounts and recommending the response.

Business Management and Profitability:

  • Forecasting the marketplace business and supplying inputs to the weekly POS-driven sales process and to supply and demand planning (SIOP).
  • Managing profitability by account, including fees, fulfillment costs, returns and promotional spend.
  • Reporting performance by account with a clear read on what is working and what to change.

Cross-Functional Partnership:

  • Partnering with Marketing, who owns marketplace advertising and retail media, on one integrated plan for the brand and the channel.
  • Working with Supply Chain, Sales Operations and Finance so supply, order management and reporting line up with the channel plan.
  • Supporting the VP, Sales with account-level input and sizing when new marketplace opportunities are evaluated.

Requirements:

  • The successful candidate will bring ownership, commercial judgment and a hands-on approach to CRNA. This person will have grown marketplace accounts in consumer products and will be comfortable working the detail of the digital shelf while keeping an eye on the P&L.
  • The ideal candidate should also possess, at minimum, the following qualifications and attributes:
  • 5+ years in e-commerce or marketplace account management in consumer products.
  • Hands-on experience growing Walmart.com and Target.com, including item setup, content, pricing and promotional planning.
  • Working knowledge of seller-model (3P) marketplaces, including fulfillment options, fees and account health.
  • Command of the digital shelf: content, search, ratings and reviews.
  • Analytical strength with POS, shipment and syndicated data, and fluency in Excel.
  • Commercial acumen across profitability by account, promotional spend, fees and fulfillment costs.
  • Working knowledge of marketplace retail media, such as Walmart Connect or Roundel, is preferred.
  • Experience in consumer durables, home or household categories is preferred.
  • Experience in a PE-backed or high-growth company is a plus.
  • A bachelor’s degree is required; an advanced degree is preferred.

Target Salary Range: $100,000 - $115,000 salary per year plus bonus. Exact pay will be based on factors including, but not limited to relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, level, geographic location, and business and organizational needs. Full-time positions are eligible for competitive benefits, including paid time off, health, dental, vision, life, disability benefits and 401(k).

raw.title: Senior DevOps Engineer - Azure & Kubernetes
raw.excerpt: Before You Apply• You must be physically located in Brazil • CVs MUST be submitted in English • Minimum Years' Experience: 5 The OpportunityWe're looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer who thrives on building secure, scalable and resilient cloud infrastructure.
raw.description:
Before You Apply

  • You must be physically located in Brazil
  • CVs MUST be submitted in English
  • Minimum Years' Experience: 5

The Opportunity

We're looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer who thrives on building secure, scalable and resilient cloud infrastructure.

You'll join an international engineering organisation responsible for the cloud platforms powering enterprise software used by customers worldwide.

Working primarily with Microsoft Azure and Kubernetes, you'll help ensure that critical applications remain secure, available and performant while making it easier for engineering teams to build, test and deploy software.

This is a hands-on role combining cloud engineering, site reliability, security and automation.

If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure challenges, eliminating repetitive tasks and improving how software is delivered, this could be an excellent opportunity.

What You'll Be Working On

Cloud Infrastructure & Kubernetes

  • Manage, maintain and optimise cloud infrastructure hosted on Microsoft Azure.
  • Operate and secure production Kubernetes environments, particularly Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Work across cloud networking, identity management, storage and Azure SQL.
  • Maintain reliable, scalable environments supporting enterprise SaaS applications.
  • Deliver platform upgrades, patches and hotfixes while minimising disruption to customers.

Site Reliability & Performance

Reliability isn't just about responding when something breaks. It's about engineering systems that are less likely to fail.

You'll be responsible for:

  • Defining and monitoring Service Level Objectives (SLOs).
  • Implementing monitoring, alerting and observability solutions.
  • Investigating production incidents and identifying root causes.
  • Participating in on-call support and coordinating incident resolution.
  • Conducting post-incident reviews and implementing lasting improvements.
  • Testing backup, restoration and disaster recovery procedures.
  • Turning recurring operational issues into automated solutions.

CI/CD & Automation

  • Design, build and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.
  • Integrate automated testing, quality checks and security controls into deployment workflows.
  • Improve software release processes to make deployments faster, safer and more predictable.
  • Establish standards for source control, development environments and release readiness.
  • Develop automation scripts using PowerShell, Python or Bash.
  • Reduce manual operational tasks through automation and infrastructure improvements.

Cloud Security

Security is an integral part of this role.

You'll help protect cloud infrastructure and customer environments by:

  • Identifying, prioritising and remediating vulnerabilities.
  • Managing security patches, certificates, secrets and access permissions.
  • Applying security best practices across Azure and Kubernetes.
  • Supporting secure configuration and maintenance of production environments.
  • Contributing to continuous improvements in infrastructure security.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Work closely with software engineers and technical teams across Europe, North America and Australia.
  • Help establish and improve engineering and operational standards.
  • Share knowledge and support other engineers in adopting DevOps best practices.
  • Create and maintain operational documentation, troubleshooting guides and runbooks.
  • Contribute to a culture of reliability, automation and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

Essential Experience

  • 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) or cloud operations.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including networking, identity, storage and Azure SQL.
  • Proven experience deploying, managing and securing Kubernetes in production, ideally using AKS.
  • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, preferably with Azure DevOps YAML.
  • Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Python or Bash.
  • Practical experience implementing monitoring, alerting and incident response processes.
  • Understanding of Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and reliability engineering principles.
  • Experience with vulnerability management, security patching and secrets management.
  • Experience supporting customer-facing production environments.
  • Familiarity with Windows Server and SQL Server.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with international teams across multiple time zones.

Nice to Have

Experience with any of the following would be an advantage:

Observability & Monitoring

  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • Loki
  • Tempo
  • OpenTelemetry

Security & Compliance

  • Microsoft Defender for Cloud
  • Azure Policy
  • ISO 27001
  • SOC 2

Deployment & Operations

  • GitOps and ArgoCD
  • Feature flag management
  • ITIL or other IT service management practices

Professional Certifications

  • Microsoft Azure: AZ-104, AZ-400 or AZ-500
  • Kubernetes: CKA or CKS

How You Work

We're looking for someone who combines strong technical expertise with a proactive engineering mindset.

You:

  • Think about reliability first. You design systems to prevent problems rather than simply reacting to them.
  • Automate whenever possible. You recognise repetitive tasks as opportunities for improvement.
  • Take ownership. You investigate problems thoroughly and follow them through to resolution.
  • Care about security. You understand that protecting infrastructure and customer data is everyone's responsibility.
  • Communicate clearly. You can explain complex technical issues to engineers and other stakeholders.
  • Keep learning. You stay informed about emerging cloud technologies, tools and engineering practices.
  • Work collaboratively. You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping your team succeed.

Why This Opportunity Stands Out

Work on infrastructure that matters

Support cloud platforms powering enterprise applications used by customers around the world.

Solve meaningful engineering challenges

Work across reliability, security, automation and cloud infrastructure rather than focusing on a single narrow area.

Make a measurable impact

Your improvements will directly influence system availability, deployment efficiency, security and the developer experience.

Collaborate internationally

Work alongside experienced engineering professionals across multiple continents.

Build for the long term

Help create reliable, secure and maintainable infrastructure that supports the continued evolution of enterprise SaaS products.

Ready for Your Next Challenge?

If you're an experienced DevOps Engineer who enjoys working with Azure, Kubernetes and modern automation technologies, we'd like to hear from you.

Apply now and help engineer the infrastructure behind tomorrow's enterprise software.

raw.excerpt: Position HighlightsLocation:This position is available for a fully remote work agreement for U.
raw.description:
Position Highlights

Location:This position is available for a fully remote work agreement for U.S. based candidates.

Salary Range:$105,000-$125,000, plus benefits

Position Type:Grant funded, limited-term opportunity contingent upon funding

Position End Date:June 30, 2027, with possibility for renewal contingent upon funding

Overview

The CDC Foundation is seeking a candidate for a full-time Senior Health Communications Specialist who will provide strategic support, technical assistance, and communications leadership for a team working to build an evidence base for effective drowning prevention strategies in the United States. This position is key to leading the development and implementation of a strategic communication plan in support of programmatic priorities and goals. This position will also lead the implementation of a wide array of health communication and dissemination activities designed to impact positive health outcomes related to water safety and drowning prevention.

The Senior Health Communications Specialist's primary responsibility will be leading communication and information dissemination for the Understanding and Preventing Drowning program. Specifically, this position will provide support in the areas of communication planning and strategy, message development, storytelling related to program initiatives, program website development and maintenance, coordination on communication strategy and output with partner organizations, and other related activities. As the Senior Health Communications Specialist, this role will lead communications strategy and initiatives for the Understanding and Preventing Drowning team, advising senior program leadership, providing communications guidance and mentorship to other program team members, and executing the program's communications activities.

A key aspect of the Senior Health Communication Specialist role will be aligning and delivering communications and other external facing outputs across a broad program portfolio that includes several partner organizations including groups delivering swim skills training to children and youth, state and local health departments, university-based research groups, and drowning prevention and water safety organizations operating at the local, state, national, and global levels.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and execution of a comprehensive strategic communications plan to advance program goals. Ensure that the program's communication activities are achieved in collaboration with key partner organizations.
  • Develop and implement communications strategies that elevate program visibility, amplify key messages, and enhance engagement across earned and social media channels.
  • Lead the creation and dissemination of communications products and supporting materials for the program.
  • Support the development of a program website including working with senior program leadership, other program team members, and web developers.
  • Work with team members and external parter organizations to identify, draft, publish, and promote new stories and other information that amplify program outputs and communicate program impacts.
  • Provide communications guidance, mentorship and support to other team members, and in some cases partner organizations.
  • Advise senior program leadership and program team members on communication strategies, message framing, media engagement and other media topics as needed.
  • Ensure that documents and other content conform to organizational policies, branding and style; and align with accepted water safety and drowning prevention terminology and best-practice safety advice.
  • Coordinate with others on health media production, publications for professional and public audiences, and electronic health communication activities.
  • Manage clearance processes for communication research, evaluation, and publications.
  • Maintain robust familiarity with scientific and non-scientific literature for project-related publications.
  • Build and maintain working relationships with communications peers internal to the CDC Foundation and with external partner organizations, including donors, government health agencies and other drowning prevention and water safety organizations to enhance collaboration, align communication strategies and increase the reach of media efforts.
  • Represents the CDC Foundation at technical and strategic planning meetings with internal and external partners.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Necessary Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, English, public health, public policy or related field required. Master's degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in the field of communications, preferably within the public health or drowning prevention-related arena, including experience developing and executing a broad range of communication and media strategies.
  • Experience independently representing organizations to media members, or past experience as a news reporter, producer, or editor.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead the production of communication products, documents and presentation materials that are high quality and error-free.
  • Experience working with diverse stakeholders, including senior leadership, subject matter experts, external partners and donor organizations.
  • Proven ability to collaborate with a team while also completing specific tasks independently, on task and timeline.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Strong understanding of communication theory and its application to strategy.
  • Experience engaging community partners and providing capacity building/skill-based support.
  • Experience working on diverse health communications and social marketing campaigns.
  • Cross-cultural competence and ability to work with a variety of partners from varying backgrounds.
  • Experience translating scientific information into easy-to-understand language for non-scientific audiences.
  • Ability to engage with, listen to and learn from a broad range of partners, encouraging meaningful participation and developing productive working relationships with colleagues and partners.
  • Strong project management skills and ability to meet deadlines, prioritize and stay organized.
  • Experience working in a virtual environment with remote partners and teams.
  • Willingness to travel domestically (up to 10% annually).
  • Experience developing and managing effective social media content that translates complex public health information into clear, engaging, and audience-appropriate messages.
  • Experience managing website content, structure, and enhancement projects, including collaborating with web developers, designers, and subject matter experts to optimize user experience.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status, and all other characteristics protected by law. We comply with all applicable laws including E.O. 11246 and the Vietnam Era Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974 governing employment practices and do not discriminate on the basis of any unlawful criteria in accordance with 41 C.F.R. §§ 60-300.5(a)(12) and 60-741.5(a)(7). As a federal government contractor, we take affirmative action on behalf of protected veterans.

The CDC Foundation is a smoke-free environment.

Relocation expenses are not included.

About the CDC Foundation

The CDC Foundation is an independent nonprofit authorized by Congress to mobilize philanthropic partners to support the public health system, including the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), in preventing and responding to threats to health. In this role, we are focused on one priority: building catalytic, flexible and impactful partnerships—with corporations, philanthropies, individuals and organizations—to help improve the health and lives of people in all communities, everywhere. Visit www.cdcfoundation.org for more information

Line of Business:

Data & Analytics

Job Description:

We are looking for a skilled data remediation analyst to ensure our ongoing compliance with FDIC Part 370, which governs recordkeeping for timely deposit insurance determination. In this position, the analyst will be responsible for conducting in-depth data remediation analysis, performing research and quality assurance on several account and customer data concerns each day, as well as identifying exception populations. Additionally, they will develop and maintain recurring reports that highlight data issues requiring remediation. The successful candidate will bring expertise in data analysis and reporting, a solid understanding of banking products, and familiarity with regulatory requirements. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills are essential, as is the ability to enhance the completeness, accuracy, traceability, and overall usability of deposit account records. These efforts are critical for robust FDIC 370 reporting, ongoing testing, and ensuring certification readiness.


Depth & Scope:

  • Conduct data remediation analysis for deposit account data elements required for FDIC Part 370 compliance, including account holder identifiers, beneficial owner information, grantor and beneficiary data, ownership right and capacity classifications, pending reason codes, and required output file fields.
  • Experience with data remediation within financial institutions is highly preferred.
  • A thorough understanding of both lending and deposit accounts will further enhance a candidate’s suitability for this position.
  • Candidates should be adept at understanding relational data sets to pinpoint specific scenarios, with a keen eye for accuracy and detail.
  • Outstanding organizational skills and effective time management are vital for success in this role.
  • The candidate should demonstrate expertise in Excel.
  • While SQL experience is not required, it would be considered a valuable asset.
  • The candidate will operate within a collaborative team environment, maintaining a clear understanding of team objectives while independently managing and executing assigned responsibilities with a high degree of accountability and professionalism.

  • Familiar with visualization tools
  • Analyzes, designs, develops data repositories, warehouses and marts, data movement, data wrangling, data mapping and transformation (ETL) processes

  • May also be responsible for developing sophisticated data preparation frameworks and architecture to create or modify data features for consumption by Data Scientists
  • Supports data modeling capabilities in order to structure business data to be consumed / translated into a variety of novel capacities
  • Supports business teams in the use and understanding of the data and reporting solutions

More than 95,000 TD colleagues bring their skills, talent, and creativity to foster deeper relationships, ensure disciplined execution, and build a simpler, faster banking experience. TD is deeply committed to being a leader in client experience, that is why we believe that all colleagues, no matter where they work, are client facing. Together, we are reimagining what banking can be for our clients, colleagues and communities.

Our Total Rewards package reflects the investments we make in our colleagues to help them and their families achieve their financial, physical and mental well-being goals. Total Rewards at TD includes base salary and variable compensation/incentive awards (e.g., eligibility for cash and/or equity incentive awards, generally through participation in an incentive plan) and several other key plans such as health and well-being benefits, savings and retirement programs, paid time off (including Vacation PTO, Flex PTO, and Holiday PTO), banking benefits and discounts, career development, and reward and recognition. Learn more

Additional Information:
We’re delighted that you’re considering building a career with TD. Through regular development conversations, training programs, and a competitive benefits plan, we’re committed to providing the support our colleagues need to thrive both at work and at home.

Colleague Development

If you’re interested in a specific career path or are looking to build certain skills, we want to help you succeed. You’ll have regular career, development, and performance conversations with your manager, as well as access to an online learning platform and a variety of mentoring programs to help you unlock future opportunities.

If you’re passionate about helping clients and building deep, lasting relationships, TD offers diverse career paths where you can grow your expertise and make a meaningful impact.

We're committed to your success and foster a respectful workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, everyone has fair opportunities to grow, and you can unlock your full potential to achieve your career goals. Here at TD, we hire and develop the best.

We will provide training and onboarding sessions to ensure that you’ve got everything you need to succeed in your new role.
