Gerente de Negocios – Servicios SAP AMS

Objetivo de la Posición

Maximizar el valor de las relaciones comerciales con los clientes existentes y desarrollar nuevas oportunidades de negocio para servicios SAP AMS (Application Management Services). El/La Gerente de Negocios liderará la construcción de relaciones sólidas e internacionales, identificará necesidades clave del cliente y garantizará su satisfacción comercial con la finalidad de incrementar las ventas, expandir la cuota de mercado y maximizar la rentabilidad de la empresa.

Funciones y Responsabilidades Principales

  • Gestión y Prospección Internacional: Identificar, abordar y cualificar prospectos e hitos comerciales en mercados internacionales para ampliar la cartera de clientes.
  • Gestión del Ciclo Integral de Ventas: Dominar de extremo a extremo el proceso comercial, desde la prospección inicial y calificación, hasta la presentación de propuestas, negociación técnica/comercial y cierre de acuerdos.
  • Posicionamiento de la Oferta de Valor: Presentar de manera persuasiva los servicios tecnológicos de NetPartners ante comités ejecutivos y tomadores de decisiones (C-Level).
  • Coordinación de Demos y Sesiones Técnicas: Organizar y liderar reuniones técnicas con el equipo especialista para realizar demostraciones efectivas de las capacidades operativas y de soporte AMS.
  • Desarrollo de Relaciones de Confianza: Establecer, cultivar y mantener lazos de largo plazo con clientes clave, posicionándose como un asesor estratégico de negocio.
  • Cumplimiento de Metas Comerciales: Alcanzar y superar consistentemente las cuotas de ventas e indicadores clave de rendimiento (KPIs) asignados.
  • Account Management y Calidad de Servicio: Dar seguimiento continuo al estado de las cuentas activas, asegurando un nivel de servicio óptimo e identificando oportunidades de venta cruzada (up-selling y cross-selling).

Requisitos y Experiencia

  • Educación: Licenciatura o Ingeniería concluida en Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería en Sistemas, Industrial, Tecnologías de Información o carreras afines.
  • Experiencia Comprobable:
    • Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en el sector B2B de tecnología, enfocado en la comercialización de servicios de tecnología y soporte gestionado SAP (AMS).
    • Demostrada trayectoria en prospección y cierre de negocios a nivel internacional.
  • Conocimientos Deseables (Valor añadido):
    • Experiencia previa de trabajo o consultoría en ecosistemas SAP.
    • Familiaridad con metodologías Ágiles (Scrum, Kanban, Agile frameworks).

Competencias Blandas y Cualidades

  • Orientación a Resultados y Métricas: Alta motivación intrínseca por alcanzar objetivos cuantitativos y cumplir/superar las cuotas comerciales fijadas.
  • Resolución de Problemas Complejos: Capacidad analítica y criterio para destrabar situaciones comerciales y operativas de alta complejidad.
  • Curiosidad Técnica y Aprendizaje Continuo: Disposición activa y autónoma para adquirir un dominio profundo de las herramientas, arquitecturas y soluciones del portafolio.
  • Autonomía y Toma de Decisiones: Capacidad para autogestionarse, priorizar la agenda comercial y tomar decisiones acertadas en entornos remotos y dinámicos.
  • Comunicación Estratégica y Capacidad de Síntesis: Dominio de la comunicación verbal y escrita para estructurar mensajes claros, sintéticos e impactantes ante audiencias técnicas y directivas.
  • Resiliencia y Trabajo Bajo Presión: Habilidad para gestionar la frustración, adaptarse a cambios de entorno y mantener la productividad en escenarios de alta exigencia.
  • Enfoque al Cliente y Trabajo en Equipo: Alta vocación de servicio para entender las necesidades del cliente y colaborar armónicamente con las áreas técnicas internas.

Condiciones de la Posición

  • País de Asignación: México
  • Modalidad de Trabajo: Remoto
  • Esquema de Contratación: Prestación de Servicios (Honorarios / Contractor)

Q2IMPACT seeks a Capture Consultant to support growth across its DoW portfolio. The role will require coordination with Q2IMPACT leadership and BD staff to ensure accurate tracking and alignment on priorities.

Key Responsibilities

Business Development and Market Expansion

Capture Management

Partnering and Teaming Strategy

Proposal Support and Execution

raw.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and commercially driven Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead the strategic growth, operational performance, and long-term value creation of a diversified Construction & Real Estate business.

The CEO will have overall responsibility for the organization's strategy, P&L, business development, construction operations, real estate development, investment decisions, people leadership, and stakeholder management.

The ideal candidate will be a proven senior executive with substantial experience in construction, property development, real estate investment, infrastructure, engineering, or related sectors, with a strong track record of scaling businesses, managing large project portfolios, and delivering sustainable profitability.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategy & Corporate Leadership

Develop and execute the company's short-, medium-, and long-term corporate strategy.

Lead business expansion across construction, property development, real estate investment, and related businesses.

Identify new markets, development opportunities, strategic partnerships, and investment opportunities.

Establish clear organizational objectives, KPIs, budgets, and performance targets.

Provide strategic recommendations and regular business updates to the Board.

2. P&L & Financial Management

Take full ownership of the company's P&L, cash flow, profitability, and financial performance.

Develop annual budgets, forecasts, capital plans, and investment strategies.

Improve margins, operational efficiency, working capital, and return on invested capital.

Oversee project economics, development feasibility, financing structures, and capital allocation.

Maintain strong relationships with banks, investors, institutional partners, and other financial stakeholders.

3. Construction & Project Delivery

Provide executive oversight of the company's construction portfolio and major development projects.

Ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget, to specification, and in compliance with applicable standards.

Establish strong project governance, cost controls, procurement processes, and risk-management frameworks.

Monitor contractor, consultant, supplier, and project-partner performance.

Ensure robust health, safety, quality, environmental, and regulatory standards across operations.

4. Real Estate Development & Investment

Lead the identification, evaluation, acquisition, development, and commercialization of real estate opportunities.

Oversee land acquisition, feasibility studies, master planning, development approvals, construction, sales/leasing, and asset disposition.

Evaluate development pipelines and investment proposals based on market demand, risk, and expected returns.

Build and maintain relationships with landowners, developers, investors, government authorities, brokers, and strategic partners.

Drive portfolio optimization and maximize the value of the company's real estate assets.

5. Business Development & Commercial Growth

Develop and execute strategies to increase revenue, market share, and profitability.

Build relationships with major corporate clients, government entities, institutional investors, developers, and strategic partners.

Lead negotiations for major contracts, joint ventures, development agreements, and strategic partnerships.

Identify opportunities for diversification and new revenue streams.

Strengthen the company's market reputation and competitive positioning.

6. Governance, Risk & Compliance

Ensure the organization operates in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, contractual obligations, and corporate governance standards.

Establish enterprise-wide risk-management practices covering financial, operational, legal, construction, market, and investment risks.

Maintain strong governance across subsidiaries, projects, joint ventures, and investments.

Ensure transparency, accountability, and effective internal controls.

7. Leadership & Organizational Development

Build, lead, and retain a high-performing executive leadership team.

Develop organizational structures and talent strategies aligned with business growth.

Establish a culture focused on accountability, execution, innovation, safety, and commercial performance.

Coach and develop senior leaders and ensure effective succession planning.

Promote collaboration across construction, development, finance, commercial, legal, sales, and operations functions.

8. Stakeholder & Government Relations

Act as the principal representative of the company with the Board, investors, regulators, government authorities, financial institutions, clients, partners, and community stakeholders.

Develop strong relationships with government and regulatory bodies relevant to construction and real estate development.

Represent the organization at industry events, investment forums, and strategic business engagements.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The CEO will be accountable for:

Revenue and EBITDA/PAT growth

Overall P&L performance

Project delivery against budget and timelines

Gross margins and project profitability

Real estate portfolio growth and asset value creation

Return on invested capital

New business and development pipeline

Cash flow and working-capital performance

Customer and stakeholder satisfaction

Safety and quality performance

Employee engagement and leadership development

Strategic partnerships and market expansion

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

15+ years of progressive leadership experience, with significant senior management exposure in construction, real estate, property development, infrastructure, engineering, or a closely related sector.

Previous experience as CEO, Managing Director, Deputy CEO, COO, Executive Director, Business Unit President, or equivalent senior leadership position.

Proven experience managing a large-scale P&L and multidisciplinary organization.

Demonstrated success in construction project delivery and/or real estate development.

Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budgeting, investment analysis, cash-flow management, and capital allocation.

Proven track record of business growth, market expansion, and value creation.

Experience managing major contractors, developers, consultants, investors, financial institutions, and government stakeholders.

Strong understanding of construction contracts, development economics, procurement, project risk, and real estate markets.

Preferred Experience

Experience managing a diversified construction and real estate group or holding company.

Exposure to large-scale residential, commercial, industrial, mixed-use, hospitality, infrastructure, or urban-development projects.

Experience with joint ventures, PPPs, institutional investors, private equity, or international development partners.

Experience leading organizational transformation, restructuring, or rapid business expansion.

International or multi-country experience is highly desirable.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Real Estate, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline.

Master's degree/MBA is preferred.

Professional qualifications in engineering, project management, finance, real estate, or related fields will be advantageous.

Core Competencies

Strategic Leadership

Commercial & Financial Acumen

P&L Management

Real Estate Development

Construction & Project Management

Investment & Capital Allocation

Business Development

Negotiation & Contract Management

Risk Management

Corporate Governance

Stakeholder Management

Government Relations

Organizational Transformation

Executive Team Leadership

Decision-Making & Problem Solving

Leadership Characteristics

The successful CEO will be:

Commercially aggressive but financially disciplined

Strategic yet highly execution-oriented

Comfortable managing complex and high-value projects

A strong negotiator and relationship builder

Data-driven and financially sophisticated

Capable of operating effectively with Boards, investors, governments, and major clients

Comfortable making high-stakes decisions in complex and rapidly changing environments

A builder of strong leadership teams and organizational culture

OVERVIEW

The Company

U.S. Financial Technology (U.S. FinTech) is seeking an experienced Senior Risk Management Associate to join our team of talented professionals. This is a full-time remote opportunity.

U.S. FinTech built and operates the largest and most advanced mortgage securitization platform in the world, supporting the Uniform Mortgage-Backed Security (UMBS) of Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac.

Supporting 70% of the mortgage-backed securities in the market, U.S. FinTech provides best-in-class single-family issuance, bond administration, disclosure, and tax services. We support a broad portfolio of products for our clients with full lifecycle management.

Our market-leading, cloud-based, end-to-end platform executes transactions on an extraordinary scale which has bolstered liquidity in the secondary mortgage market, one of the largest and most important financial markets in the world. Our unique approach to securitization combines the best minds in financial services with the know-how, flexibility, and innovation of leading technologists.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Job Information

This role will report to the Sr. Director of Enterprise Risk Programs & Risk Intelligence to provide tactical execution of various ERM Programs and Risk Management Training Programs. The Associate role will assist the Sr. Director with managing Second Line of Defense (SLOD) risk governance function and annual ERM Plan development/documentation. The role will also participate in Operational Process mapping of key Issuance, Administration of MBS activities.

This role requires with demonstrated risk management experience in supporting cross-functional business areas and corporate stakeholders relative to effective and timely identification, analysis, remediation, management, and reporting of risk to various management levels and committees.

A successful candidate will have a collaborative work ethic/style, strong communication/presentation (verbal and written) and negotiation skills, and demonstrated knowledge and experience in industry best practices and standards relative to Enterprise Risk Management and knowledge in multiple risk disciplines.

Key Job Functions

  • Collaboratively assist in the development, promoting, and tracking of ERM related projects and programs implementations, process mapping leveraging project management professional (PMP) methodologies and practices.

  • Assist leadership in the planning, execution, tracking and reporting on ERM related programs, projects, and initiatives, with all impacted business and corporate stakeholders, to completion.

  • Develop project/program plans of action, including tasks/deliverables, milestones, and definitive timelines.

  • Participate in periodic meetings with impacted business/corporate stakeholders, and others to ensure accurate, comprehensive, and timely minutes, tracking and reporting on ERM tasks, issues and concerns relative to implementation of programs, initiatives, and projects, through to completion.

  • Ensure records management of ERM programs is maintained.

  • Work directly with front-line management up to and including Executives to assist with program, initiative and/or project statuses.

  • Escalate material risks, issues, or challenges to ERM leadership, impacted stakeholders, and their management, as necessary, and coordinate timely awareness and resolution of impediments to keep initiatives on schedule.

  • Interact with Internal Audit, Compliance, and FHFA regulators to ensure open communication and transparency.

  • Develop project management methodologies, metrics, reporting and systems, as appropriate, to quantify and accurately monitor progress.

  • Provide quality assurance to reporting, artifacts and assertions.

  • Parter with the business to develop plans to mitigate risk and program performance issues.

  • Serve as a connection point and subject-matter expert between business units and Risk Management by fostering partnerships and collaborating as a risk liaison coordinator.

  • Collaborate as an ambassador to champion ERM’ Risk Management plan and priorities through proactive education of and engagement with business units, across US Fintech.

  • Perform gap and data analysis to address program gaps or deficiencies.

  • Assess the needs of the organization or individuals for risk management training, including design, develop, and assist in the delivery of risk management training programs to meet those needs.

  • Evaluate the effectiveness of training programs and make improvements as necessary.

  • Create and distribute learning materials such as newsletters, presentations, and exercises.

  • Stay up-to-date with the latest developments in risk management.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • At a minimum, a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited 4-year college or university.
  • Preferred candidate will have obtained or in process of completing Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
  • Preferred candidate will have obtained or working towards Scrum Master Certification and be familiar with Agile process mapping practices

Minimum Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years' related work experience in Risk Management and/or Consulting.

  • Minimum 3 years of related work experience in risk management programs or project management, hardware/software implementations, including Governance Risk and Control (GRC) tool implementations.

  • Minimum of 2-3 years of demonstrated experience in process mapping or project management. (Agile environment and familiarity with methodology).

  • Applicants must be authorized to work in the US without requiring employer sponsorship currently or in the future. U.S. FinTech does not offer H-1B sponsorship for this position.

Specialized Knowledge & Skills

  • Ability to work effectively in an evolving, virtual work environment with cross-functional, innovative teams.
  • Contribute to knowledge-sharing, encouragement, and respect in a virtual environment.
  • Ability to proactively identify Risk Program enhancements and issues, complete research, and present and/or implement solutions with management support.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to credibly challenge peers and business partners, and to effectively convey identified/potential risk exposure and required remediation actions to corporate stakeholders and management
  • Knowledgeable in the usage and functionality of Microsoft Office Products, specifically: Outlook – Advanced User; Word – Advanced User; Excel – Moderate User; Visio and PowerBI – Moderate User, process mapping tools like Visio or similar.

Pay Range $123,500 to $142,000

U.S. FinTech's pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law. U.S. FinTech offers a competitive total compensation package, which includes a performance bonus, 401k match, healthcare coverage, PTO, and a broad range of other benefits.

Employment

As a condition of employment with U.S. Financial Technology, any successful job applicant will be required to successfully complete a background investigation, which may also include a credit check for positions in some areas of our business.

U.S. Financial Technology is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

About the assignment

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer. You'll own fraud forensics for our identity and verification platform, which verifies users through phone-number and OTP verification. We are seeing a surge in sophisticated fraud attacks on that flow, including SMS pumping campaigns targeting specific regions, while tuning critical anti-fraud thresholds where every rule change trades blocked attackers against legitimate users lost at signup. You'll investigate attacks, triage patterns, and turn findings into rules and monitoring our backend engineers can skip so they stay focused on core platform work. You'll own this space end to end while we hire a permanent team member, and leave behind detection the team can run without you.

Responsibilities

  • Fraud forensics: investigate active and past attacks on OTP and verification flows; quantify volume, cost and user impact; produce clear incident write-ups.

  • Attack triage: identify patterns across country, carrier, number range, device and attestation signals; separate SMS pumping, bot traffic and account abuse from legitimate spikes.

  • Threshold tuning: analyse and backtest anti-fraud rules and thresholds; quantify false positives (legitimate users blocked) against fraud prevented; recommend changes with evidence.

  • Detection and monitoring: turn recurring forensics into scheduled queries, dashboards and alerts so attacks are caught in hours, not after the provider invoice.

  • Engineering hand-off: give backend engineers precise, ready-to-implement rule proposals so they stay focused on platform delivery.

  • Knowledge transfer: document playbooks and coach our analytics engineer so capability stays in the team.

Requirements

Mandatory

  • 5+ years in analytics engineering, data science or fraud analytics, with at least 2 years hands-on in fraud or abuse detection.

  • Expert SQL on BigQuery: large event tables, window functions, partition-aware and cost-efficient queries.

  • Strong Python (pandas, notebooks) for ad-hoc forensics and pattern mining.

  • Building scheduled pipelines in Airflow and dashboards in Looker (or equivalent BI).

  • Experience tuning rule- or threshold-based fraud controls, including backtesting and false-positive analysis.

  • Works independently from day one; communicates findings crisply to engineers and leadership.

Nice-to-have

  • Experience investigating telecom or SMS fraud (SMS pumping / artificially inflated traffic, IRSF) at scale.

  • Hands-on with CPaaS provider logs and billing data (Vonage, Twilio, Sinch, Infobip).

  • Identity and verification domain: OTP funnels, rate limiting, velocity rules, device attestation (Play Integrity, App Attest).

  • Experience with fraud in emerging markets (Africa, South Asia), where carrier and pricing patterns differ.

  • Event streams from Kafka; streaming anomaly detection (Dataflow/Flink).

  • Statistical anomaly detection or lightweight ML (BigQuery ML, isolation forests).

Additional info

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We believe a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences strengthens our products and our culture. No matter where you're from, what language you speak, or how you identify, we value what makes you unique. This is an urgent contract engagement and we will move as soon as we find the right person, so please apply as soon as possible. As part of the recruitment process, client will conduct a background check. We only accept applications in English.

High-level summary

Support the company as an HVAC Operations Manager responsible for helping the CEO manage day-to-day office operations, team coordination, administrative workflows, and service-related support.

This role is ideal for someone with strong HVAC industry knowledge, excellent organization skills, leadership ability, and a willingness to learn and take ownership of tasks.

The person in this role will act as the CEO's right hand, working closely with the CEO and another office assistant to keep operations organized, tasks assigned, and the business running smoothly.

About the Company:

An HVAC service business that supports customers with heating, ventilation, and air conditioning needs.

The company requires strong office leadership and operational support to help manage daily administrative tasks, customer/service workflows, internal coordination, and team follow-through.

Company core values:

  • Industry expertise — values team members who understand the HVAC field and can support operations with practical industry knowledge.
  • Organization — committed to keeping office workflows, customer needs, schedules, and internal tasks organized.
  • Leadership — encourages ownership, accountability, and the ability to guide others in daily operations.
  • Continuous learning — values someone who is willing to learn, improve, and grow with the company.
  • Dependability — prioritizes follow-through, reliability, and consistent support for the CEO, office team, and customers.

Objective of this role:

  • Serve as the CEO's right hand in managing office operations and HVAC-related administrative workflows.
  • Help organize, assign, and monitor tasks between the office team and internal operations.
  • Use HVAC industry knowledge to support scheduling, customer communication, job coordination, and service-related administration.
  • Provide leadership and structure to ensure tasks are completed accurately and on time.

Office management and CEO support

  • Support the CEO with daily office operations, administrative tasks, and business priorities.
  • Act as a key point of support for organizing tasks, tracking follow-ups, and keeping operations moving.
  • Assist the CEO in assigning tasks to the office assistant and monitoring completion.
  • Help identify what needs attention, what needs to be delegated, and what needs follow-up.

HVAC operations support

  • Use HVAC industry knowledge to support service-related office workflows.
  • Assist with organizing customer requests, job details, service needs, and internal updates.
  • Help ensure HVAC-related information is communicated accurately and clearly.
  • Support coordination between the office, field team, and leadership as needed.

Team coordination and leadership

  • Work closely with the CEO and office assistant to coordinate daily priorities.
  • Help guide office workflows and ensure assigned tasks are completed.
  • Communicate expectations clearly and follow up on outstanding work.
  • Support a productive, organized, and accountable office environment.

Administrative organization

  • Maintain organized files, records, schedules, customer information, and operational documents.
  • Help manage recurring office tasks, follow-ups, and internal processes.
  • Support process improvements to make office operations more efficient.
  • Keep information accurate, accessible, and up to date.

Customer and internal communication

  • Communicate professionally with customers, team members, vendors, and internal staff as needed.
  • Help ensure customer requests or service-related concerns are routed and followed up on properly.
  • Provide clear updates to the CEO regarding task status, issues, or operational needs.

Required skills and qualifications:

  • HVAC industry experience.
  • Strong understanding of HVAC office operations, service workflows, or field-related coordination.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Leadership ability and comfort assigning, tracking, or coordinating tasks.
  • Willingness to learn, adapt, and take on more responsibility over time.
  • Ability to act as a right hand to the CEO and provide dependable daily support.
  • Strong communication skills with customers, internal team members, and leadership.
  • Proactive, accountable, and able to follow through with minimal supervision.
  • Detail-oriented and able to keep office information, tasks, and workflows organized.
  • Comfortable working closely with another office assistant and supporting team productivity.

Preferred skills and qualifications:

  • Prior experience as an HVAC Office Manager, Service Coordinator, Dispatcher, Administrative Manager, or Operations Assistant.

  • Experience leading or supervising administrative staff.
  • Familiarity with HVAC service software, CRM systems, scheduling tools, or office management platforms.
  • Experience improving office processes, organizing workflows, or creating structure in a growing service business.

What You'll Do

  • Prepare and manage journal entries, invoices, account reconciliations, and other month-end and year-end closing activities.

  • Help improve data integrity, financial reporting, and accounting efficiency throughout the dealership organization.
  • Participate in management meetings and work with leaders across the organization to support business needs.

These responsibilities closely reflect the company's description of the Assistant Controller as supporting accounting management, financial statements, close, budgeting/forecasting, audits, management reporting, internal controls, and accounting-system processes.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university, related accounting experience/training, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Demonstrated know-how to integrate Vantage with external platforms, including importing and exporting data between Vantage and MicroSoft Dataverse/Power Platform is highly desired. This position offers an opportunity to provide technical leadership while strategically growing the development footprint with customers. Candidates should be comfortable working in a fast-paced, flexible environment and be self-directed, collaborative, and eager to grow technically. Candidates with the ability to be on-site in Pittsburgh are preferred.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Design and develop enterprise applications using Microsoft Power Platform, Dataverse, Power Apps, Power Automate, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Power Query
  • Scale Dataverse solutions with tables, data types, data mapping and entity relationship diagrams
  • Co-lead data engineering efforts within Palantir Foundry (Vantage), including ontology design, pipeline development, and data integration for Army AI2C mission applications
  • Build, maintain, and optimize Foundry pipelines using Python-based transforms (PySpark/Pipeline Builder), Code Repositories, and Foundry’s data connection framework as a key member of tech team
  • Develop and maintain data engineering workflows in Databricks, including notebooks, Delta Lake tables, and Spark jobs, for workloads that complement or feed into the Foundry environment
  • Advise and help write, design, and implement efficient, reusable, and reliable code using Python, PySpark, SQL, and TypeScript/JavaScript as needed for Foundry Workshop or Slate applications
  • Translate complex data science and analytics outputs into governed, reusable data products surfaced through Foundry and Databricks
  • Lead the integration of AI/ML capabilities into Foundry and Databricks-based applications, identifying opportunities to leverage emerging AI technologies (including Foundry AIP and Databricks ML/AI tooling)
  • Champion AI-forward, platform-first development practices and guide the team in implementing AI/ML features and data-driven experiences
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to grow the team’s capabilities across Foundry (Vantage) and Databricks
  • Identify and pursue opportunities to expand development initiatives with Army stakeholders
  • Collaborate effectively with data scientists, UX designers, and software developers using Git, participating in code reviews and adopting Agile methodologies
  • Engage with Army managers and representatives in a consultative capacity to identify data platform needs, explore innovative data-driven solutions including AI applications, and build strategic relationships that expand our development footprint
  • Comfortable working independently and as a member of a team, with demonstrated ability to work in strategic and consultant-oriented environments
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with ability to articulate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and influence strategic decisions

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent work experience
  • 3-5 years of experience in data engineering, with hands-on experience building and operating applications on the Palantir Foundry (Vantage) platform
  • Demonstrated experience with Microsoft Power Platform, Dataverse, Power Apps and Power Automate for a Defense client/customer
  • Preliminary experience with Databricks, including notebooks, Delta Lake, and Spark-based data processing, as a secondary platform to Foundry
  • Intermediate proficiency in Python and SQL for data manipulation and pipeline development (pandas, PySpark, numpy, or similar)
  • Familiarity with data visualization approaches (Power BI, D3.js, Plotly, Recharts, or Foundry-native Workshop widgets) for surfacing pipeline outputs
  • Demonstrated experience in planning, analyzing, designing, implementing, testing, and maintaining data pipelines and applications for an enterprise-level system
  • Familiarity with Git, Agile methodologies, CI/CD, and automated deployments
  • Demonstrated experience in leadership roles, technical mentorship, or client relationship management
  • Active Secret Clearance or ability to obtain one is required

Additional Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience integrating AI/ML capabilities into Foundry or Databricks-based applications and identifying strategic AI use cases
  • Familiarity with AI frameworks and APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, LangChain, or similar) and with Foundry AIP
  • Knowledge of statistical analysis and machine learning concepts
  • Experience with Storybook for component development, documentation, and design system management
  • Hands-on deployment experience across multiple environments and platforms, including classified/air-gapped Foundry instances
  • Knowledge of the Army software development process and its technologies or experience developing applications for classified data
  • Background working in strategic planning or consultant environments supporting government or DoD clients
  • Proven track record of expanding technical scope or footprint with government customers
  • 7+ years of directly related experience
  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related field
  • On-site (Pittsburgh) candidates preferred

Applicants must meet eligibility requirements for a U.S. Government security clearance. Only US Citizens are eligible for a security clearance. For this position, LMI will only consider applicants with security clearances or applicants who are eligible for security clearances, due to the nature of the work.

raw.description:
Position Description

Valiant Solutions is seeking an IHE Cybersecurity Compliance & Incident Response Specialist to provide senior cybersecurity compliance, breach response, incident management, and risk management support for institutions of higher education (IHEs) that handle sensitive federal data. You will help our government customer respond to cybersecurity incidents at institutions outside its system boundary, including incidents that may involve Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI), Federal Tax Information (FTI), and Personally Identifiable Information (PII). You will coordinate response and remediation, manage IHE cybersecurity cases through closure, and evaluate institutional cybersecurity compliance. Your guidance, grounded in NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 3, will help institutions strengthen how they protect sensitive federal information.

Named one of the Washington Business Journal’sBest Places to Work every year since 2014, Valiant is proud of our employee-centric culture and commitment to excellence. If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now!

Location: Remote with ad hoc travel to the Washington DC Metro area.

This position allows for 100% remote work. Remote work requires a high level of trust in our employees, and we strictly adhere to the details outlined in our Remote Work Policy below.

Required Clearance: Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance

Eligibility Requirements: U.S. citizenship is required to obtain the necessary clearance for this position.

Required Experience:

  • More than 10 years of experience in cybersecurity incident response, incident handling, cybersecurity compliance, security assessments, or cyber risk management.
  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Assurance, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • A senior industry professional certification such as CISSP or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated experience investigating, coordinating, documenting, and managing cybersecurity incidents through remediation and closure.
  • Experience conducting or supporting cybersecurity compliance assessments and evaluating technical, administrative, and physical safeguards.
  • Strong knowledge of incident containment, remediation, recovery, corrective action tracking, and cybersecurity risk management.
  • Experience evaluating security controls and identifying compliance gaps and remediation requirements.
  • Experience working with sensitive or regulated information such as CUI, PII, FTI, or comparable protected data.
  • Ability to analyze complex cybersecurity information and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Excellent technical writing, analytical, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with government personnel, institutional stakeholders, cybersecurity teams, auditors, technical personnel, and organizational leadership.
  • Familiarity with NIST SP 800-61 Revision 3.
  • Strong knowledge of applicable cybersecurity regulatory and control frameworks.

Responsibilities:

Incident Response and Breach Management

  • Provide senior cybersecurity incident response and breach management support for IHEs that handle federal data.
  • Provide incident reporting and handling guidance that helps IHEs contain, remediate, and recover from cybersecurity incidents.
  • Coordinate remediation and incident response activities with reporting institutions.
  • Categorize, analyze, document, track, and manage IHE cybersecurity cases through closure.
  • Coordinate breach response activities across affected customer offices, customer contractors, IHEs, and affiliated organizations.
  • Analyze incident information and supporting evidence to identify cybersecurity risks, compliance concerns, affected data, and required remediation.
  • Track remediation activities and corrective actions through resolution.
  • Develop incident reports, technical findings, recommendations, case documentation, and status updates for customer stakeholders.

Cybersecurity Compliance and Assessments

  • Conduct and support cybersecurity compliance assessments for institutions and systems that handle federal data.
  • Evaluate the adequacy of administrative, technical, and physical safeguards and identify cybersecurity and compliance gaps.
  • Develop assessment plans that address methodology, data collection, sampling, reporting timelines, and risk-rating methodology.
  • Evaluate institutional information security programs and the implementation of required cybersecurity safeguards.
  • Review compliance audit information to determine whether identified requirements have been implemented or are addressed through acceptable corrective action plans.
  • Assess safeguards across areas including risk assessment, identity and access management, data classification and inventory, encryption, multi-factor authentication, change management and secure development, logging and monitoring, incident response capabilities, vendor and third-party risk management, and cybersecurity awareness and training.

Risk Management and Remediation

  • Identify cybersecurity risks and control weaknesses that affect how IHEs protect federal information.
  • Provide actionable remediation recommendations based on assessment and incident findings.
  • Support IHE corrective action planning and remediation efforts.
  • Provide cybersecurity consulting, threat advisories, and remediation support to participating institutions.
  • Work with institutional security teams and customer stakeholders to resolve cybersecurity and compliance issues.
  • Ensure assessment and incident response work products meet applicable agency data handling and CUI protection requirements.

Stakeholder Coordination and Technical Guidance

  • Serve as a senior cybersecurity resource to the customer and participating institutions on compliance and incident response matters.
  • Communicate complex cybersecurity incidents, vulnerabilities, compliance gaps, and remediation requirements clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Coordinate activities across IHE stakeholders, customer offices, contractors, cybersecurity personnel, and other affected organizations.
  • Support cybersecurity awareness activities and tabletop exercises with IHEs.
  • Provide senior guidance to less-experienced cybersecurity professionals, as assigned.

About Valiant Solutions

Valiant Solutions delivers cybersecurity and IT services to federal civilian, defense, and national security customers nationwide. We support the full cyber lifecycle, from secure system design and accreditation through AI-enabled operations, threat emulation, and continuous improvement, across classified and unclassified environments. Our work is independently certified for quality and security, including CMMI, CMMC, and ISO certifications.

Valiant is a multi-year Washington Business Journal Best Places to Work winner, and our growth and cyber leadership have been recognized by Washington Technology, Northern Virginia Technology Council, and the Triangle Business Journal. We offer strong benefits, rewards for earning industry certifications, and room to grow your career as we grow. Headquartered in McLean, Virginia, our distributed workforce supports customers from coast to coast. We go where the stakes are highest, and the margin for error is zero. If you want meaningful work alongside talented professionals, apply today.

Benefits Snapshot

Valiant takes care of the people who support our customers, with real choices in coverage and real investment in your career. Eligible full-time employees receive:

  • A choice of medical plans, from an affordable HSA option to a full-featured PPO, with generous company contributions
  • Dental and vision coverage for you and your family
  • Company-paid life, short-term disability, and long-term disability insurance
  • Optional supplemental life, accident, and critical illness coverage to round out your protection
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Paid time off that grows with your years of service, plus paid federal holidays
  • Paid certifications, professional development, and the Valiant University training portal
  • Flexible spending accounts and a wellness and fitness program
  • Referral bonuses when you help us bring great people to Valiant

Benefit eligibility and plan details are subject to the terms of each plan and may change from time to time.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $135,000 to $150,000. This range reflects Valiant Solutions' good-faith estimate of the base salary reasonably expected for this position upon hire, at the time of posting. The range has been established based on the scope of the role, market rates, and internal equity. Where a candidate falls within the posted range will depend on job-related factors, including relevant skills, experience, qualifications, achievements, education, geographic location, applicable security clearance requirements, additional corporate responsibilities, and other legitimate, non-discriminatory business considerations. The posted range does not guarantee an offer at any particular salary. In addition to base salary, this position includes the benefits described above.

Remote Work Policy (Remote and Hybrid Positions Only)

Remote work necessitates a high level of trust in our employees. To ensure that employee performance does not suffer in a remote work environment, all employees who telecommute are expected to have a quiet and distraction-free workspace with adequate internet, dedicate their full attention and availability to their job duties during working hours, and maintain a schedule during core business hours that aligns with those of their coworkers and Valiant's clients. In alignment with Valiant's inclusive and engaging environment, cameras are encouraged and can be required to be on during virtual video conferences. Additionally, in alignment with the Office of the Inspector General’s effort to eliminate conflicting employment, all Valiant employees are required to disclose any current or future outside employment engagements. During onboarding and throughout employment, employees must disclose any current activities or intent to engage in outside employment or other professional activities and obtain written approval. Employees may not solicit or conduct any outside business during core business hours for Valiant Solutions and our clients.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Valiant Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Valiant Solutions provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need an accommodation during the application or hiring process, please contact .

Physical Demands

Sitting or standing at a desk for prolonged periods and consistently operating a computer. Frequent communication and exchanging of accurate information via electronic communication, phones, and in person. Occasionally lift and/or move moderate amounts of weight, typically less than 20 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information

By submitting your resume for this position, you authorize Valiant Solutions to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates, and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education, and experience. Should Valiant Solutions or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

Career Category

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Position summary

The National Account Manager, Market Access Employer Engagement, is a strategic, external-facing member of US Market Access. Reporting to the Director, Employer Engagement - Obesity, this role leads engagement with a defined portfolio of jumbo employers and the organizations that shape their health-benefit decisions, including employer benefit consultants, coalitions, TPAs, PBMs, carriers, point-solution partners and, where relevant, IDNs. The Account Manager helps customers navigate evidence-based approaches to obesity and other Amgen therapeutic areas as assigned, with the goal of enabling appropriate patient access, sustainable benefit design and improved population-health outcomes.

This role combines consultative account leadership with deep market access expertise. The Account Manager develops account strategies, uncovers customer needs and market barriers, coordinates compliant Amgen resources, and translates field insight into enterprise strategy, evidence generation, tools and launch readiness. Success is measured by the quality and strategic depth of customer engagement, access progress within priority accounts, actionable insight and cross-functional impact - not by traditional sales call activity alone.


Key responsibilities

Own a strategic regional portfolio of priority jumbo employers and employer ecosystem accounts; create and execute account plans that define customer objectives, stakeholder maps, access barriers, value exchange, actions, measures and escalation needs.

Build trusted, senior-level relationships with employer benefits, total rewards, pharmacy, medical, finance and procurement leaders, as well as EBCs, consultants, coalition leaders, TPAs, PBMs, carriers and appropriate point-solution partners.

Lead consultative discussions on obesity benefit design, access and affordability, utilization-management approaches, patient journey and population-health outcomes, within approved Amgen strategy and compliant engagement models.

Identify and advance appropriate access opportunities through the employer decision ecosystem; coordinate with internal market access strategy, contracting, brand, medical, HEOR/RWE, value communications, patient support and field teams.

Translate Amgen clinical, economic and real-world evidence into customer-relevant value discussions; identify evidence gaps and bring actionable needs to HEOR/RWE and strategy partners.

Develop scalable employer-facing capabilities, including account tools, meeting-in-a-box content, market insights and solution concepts that support launch readiness and sustained engagement.

Monitor and communicate employer benefit, PBM, vendor, policy and competitive trends. Deliver concise, decision-ready insights that inform segmentation, account prioritization, contracting, evidence generation and brand strategy.

Represent Amgen at employer, consultant and coalition meetings and selected industry forums; expand the organization’s external presence and credibility in the employer market.

Maintain rigorous account documentation, CRM hygiene, performance tracking and compliance with all legal, regulatory, privacy and company requirements.

Conduct field sales support as necessary to drive pull through of coverage opportunities and resolve billing and coding issues related to Amgen products


Basic qualifications

· Doctorate degree and 2 years of sales, marketing, market access, employer benefits or payer experience; OR Master’s degree and 4 years; OR Bachelor’s degree and 6 years; OR Associate’s degree and 10 years; OR High school diploma or GED and 12 years of relevant experience.

· Three or more years of customer-facing strategic account management, market access, payer, employer-benefits, consulting, PBM, health-plan, coalition or relevant healthcare experience.

· Ability to travel domestically up to 60 percent of the time, including overnight travel, as business needs require.


Preferred qualifications

· Direct experience with self-insured jumbo employers, employer benefit consultants, employer coalitions, TPAs, PBMs, carriers or health-benefit point solutions.

·Demonstrated ability to influence access, coverage, benefit design, affordability or population-health decisions in a complex healthcare ecosystem.

· Strong knowledge of employer-sponsored benefits, pharmacy and medical benefit management, utilization management, managed care and contracting concepts.

·Experience in obesity, cardiometabolic disease, chronic-condition management, population health, value-based care or another complex therapeutic area.

· Ability to interpret and communicate clinical, HEOR/RWE, claims or utilization data in an executive-level, customer-relevant manner.

·Proven cross-functional leadership without direct authority, strong executive presentation skills and disciplined account-planning execution.

·MBA, PharmD, MPH or other advanced degree preferred.


Critical success profile

The ideal candidate is commercially rigorous and customer-centered: able to hold an informed conversation about affordability without reducing the relationship to price, elevate evidence without becoming academic, and coordinate the right Amgen resources without overpromising. They create value before a coverage decision, use insight to shape the enterprise, and bring disciplined follow-through to a complex, long-cycle employer market.


What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

  • A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts
  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
  • Stock-based long-term incentives
  • Award-winning time-off plans
  • Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies.

Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.

OVERVIEW

The Company

U.S. Financial Technology (U.S. FinTech) is seeking an experienced Lead, Governance, Risk and Compliance to join our team of talented professionals. This is a full-time remote opportunity.

U.S. FinTech built and operates the largest and most advanced mortgage securitization platform in the world, supporting the Uniform Mortgage-Backed Security (UMBS) of Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac.

Supporting 70% of the mortgage-backed securities in the market, U.S. FinTech provides best-in-class single-family issuance, bond administration, disclosure, and tax services. We support a broad portfolio of products for our clients with full lifecycle management.

Our market-leading, cloud-based, end-to-end platform executes transactions on an extraordinary scale which has bolstered liquidity in the secondary mortgage market, one of the largest and most important financial markets in the world. Our unique approach to securitization combines the best minds in financial services with the know-how, flexibility, and innovation of leading technologists.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Job Information

The Lead, Governance, Risk and Compliance, has strong critical and strategic thinking skills, and is an excellent communicator who enjoys collaborating with the team. The position will focus on risk management and compliance programs, including risks and controls, training and outreach, program/project management and scenario analysis. The ideal candidate has experience in risk management, project management, scenario analysis, and is passionate about process transformation and optimization.

The role will report to the Manager, Records Management and Compliance.

Key Job Functions

  • First Line Control Testing – Lead First Line Control Testing, plan, design, oversee and execute control testing in accordance with the enterprise control testing program standard, with support from other team members. Analyze results and provide recommendations to management, including with regard to process optimization, interacting with all levels of management to review progress and results.

  • Training and Outreach – Lead training program for Compliance and ERM working with the Principal, Human Capital Programs, coordinating content, delivery and reporting on approximately 15 internal training requirements, including role-based training and certifications. Independently work with leaders within Compliance and ERM to advance training goals, and, where appropriate, design and develop content, assess needs for additional training, evaluate the effectiveness of training programs, create and distribute learning materials and assist with Compliance outreach such as Compliance and Ethics Week.

  • Operations—Manage and coordinate (i) enterprise responses to GSE Vendor Assessments and government surveys, (ii) Compliance responses to PwC financial audit and SOC requests and (iii) departmental liaison for BCP/DR. Also, lead initiatives to organize document management system and electronically tag records, working with the Records team.

  • Business Risk and Control Champions Program – As requested, serve as Program Lead for the Company’s risk and control liaison program, including agenda and content development, tracking and reporting on initiatives, decisions and follow up. Serve as the connection point and where appropriate, subject matter expert, between business units and second line (ERM, Compliance), fostering partnerships and collaboration.

  • Scenario Analysis – Lead scenario analysis exercises focused on Financial Crimes risk, working with the Cross Functional Financial Crimes Working Group, one or two per year, may be short or long tail. Work directly with management from all areas.

  • Project/Program Manager, including GRC Tool—Serve as program/project manager for Compliance and possibly ERM, initiatives, including Governance, Risk and Compliance tool, special projects such as AI and the like, leveraging project management professional (PMP) methodologies and practices. Develop project/program plans of action, including tasks/deliverables, milestones, and definitive timelines. Track, report and follow up on project progress, issues, and risks to ensure timely high quality project delivery. Engage in subject matter as appropriate; perform gap and data analysis to address program gaps or deficiencies.

  • Special Projects – Manage and administer special projects based on departmental needs, also intended as growth opportunities.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university.
  • Preferred candidate will maintain a Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.

Minimum Experience

  • Minimum 7-8 years of related work experience in project management and/or risk management, with an interest in process optimization.
  • Applicants must be authorized to work in the US without requiring employer sponsorship currently or in the future. U.S. FinTech does not offer H-1B sponsorship for this position.

Specialized Knowledge & Skills

  • Excellent critical thinking and analytical skills, good communicator, and attention to detail.
  • Talented, energetic and engaged team player, who effectively manages programs and initiatives, identifying problems, finding solutions, and suggesting improvement opportunities
  • Strong troubleshooting and organizational skills, including ability to work on multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Build and maintain effective, highly collaborative relationships with cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Knowledgeable in the usage and functionality of Project Management tracking and reporting tools; Microsoft Office Products, specifically: Outlook – Advanced User; Word – Advanced User; Teams—Moderate User; Excel – Moderate User; Visio – Moderate User; Jira – Moderate User.

Pay Range $132,000 to $156,500

U.S. FinTech's pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law. U.S. FinTech offers a competitive total compensation package, which includes a performance bonus, 401k match, healthcare coverage, PTO, and a broad range of other benefits.
